title: Spherical law for optimal layouts of random graphs
summary: Can the nodes of a random graph be placed in an auxiliary space $\mathbb{R}^{M}$ so that its connectivity becomes local? The spring electric layout is a standard algorithm to try to find such local graph layouts; we study it as a statistical-physics problem by considering the Gibbs ensemble of spring-electric layouts. For graphs with independent edges we solve the model exactly at large number of nodes $N$ and fixed embedding dimension $M$. The node positions obey a spherical law: they are uniformly distributed in an $M$-dimensional ball; for $M=2$ this is closely related to Girko's circular law. Crucially, the ground state energy is flat across all layouts with that density: an optimal layout for one graph is asymptotically optimal for any other. Optimal layouts of i.i.d. graphs are therefore frustrated liquids, macroscopically constrained but microscopically unoptimizable. We discuss relations to graph-partitioning, Laplacian eigenmaps, and dimensionality reduction, and outline how this harsh result breaks down for correlated graphs.

AI.tldr: 该文将弹簧电学图布局视为Gibbs系综，在独立边随机图、节点数N很大且嵌入维数M固定时精确求解；发现最优布局的节点在M维球内均匀分布，基态能量对同密度布局平坦，最优布局对任一i.i.d.图渐近通用，表现为宏观受约束但微观不可优化的阻挫液体。
AI.motivation: 探讨随机图的节点能否嵌入辅助空间R^M使连通性局部化，并从统计物理角度理解弹簧电布局这一标准图布局算法，及其与图划分、Laplacian eigenmaps和降维的联系。
AI.method: 构造弹簧电学布局的Gibbs系综，将图布局问题转化为统计物理模型；针对具有独立边的随机图，在N趋于无穷、M固定的极限下精确求解。
AI.result: 节点位置服从球面律：在M维球内均匀分布，M=2时与Girko圆律密切相关；基态能量在所有具有该密度的布局间平坦，即一个图的最优布局渐近上也适用于其他图；i.i.d.图的最优布局是阻挫液体，宏观密度受约束但微观不可优化。
AI.conclusion: 对独立边随机图，低维局部化布局缺乏图特异的微观优化结构，弹簧电布局的“最优”结果具有渐近通用性；该严厉结论会在图具有相关性时失效，说明相关结构是获得有意义布局优化的关键。

title: Existence of the thermodynamic limit for the Hopfield model
summary: We prove that the quenched pressure of the Hopfield model with $K\sim\alpha N$ i.i.d. symmetric Rademacher patterns has a thermodynamic limit at every load $\alpha\in(0,\infty)$, finite inverse temperature and uniform external field, with no replica-symmetry, order-parameter concentration or non-condensation hypothesis required. The limit is the supremum over $r$ of limiting pressures of mixed models with $r$ binary patterns in a Gaussian bulk. Via the Hubbard--Stratonovich representation we extract the finitely many patterns whose hidden coordinates exceed $\delta\sqrt N$; a collective interpolation replaces the other binary patterns by Gaussian ones with error $O(\delta^2)$ uniform in the volume, and convex concentration on the discrete cube controls the disorder-dependent choice of retained patterns. For the mixed models we prove a Gaussian hidden-spin truncation bound uniform in the volume and in an arbitrary Ising potential, and convergence for Gaussian bulks with finitely many site-field types, reducing to results of Ho and of Chen, Ho and Issa on non-convex vector spin glasses with compact spins. For Gaussian patterns we give an alternative proof of the existence result announced by Camilli, Contucci and Mingione, extended to a uniform field and an extra binary pattern. In both cases the pressure has exponentially small deviation probabilities and converges a.s.; internal energy and entropy converge wherever the limit is differentiable. An extra binary Mattis pattern admits a scalar variational reduction. At zero field the Rademacher pressure dominates the Gaussian one with an extra binary pattern, which dominates the pure Gaussian one. No explicit formula is given. The proofs were generated through extensive interaction with the AI models Claude (Opus~5.5) and ChatGPT (Sol~6.1), based on the problem formulation and guidance of the authors.

AI.tldr: 该文证明：具有 K∼αN 个独立同分布对称 Rademacher 模式的 Hopfield 模型，在任意载荷 α∈(0,∞)、有限逆温和均匀外场下，其淬火压力存在热力学极限，且无需复制对称性、序参量集中性或非凝聚性假设。
AI.motivation: 目标是在 Hopfield 模型中尽量少地依赖传统平均场假设，证明淬火压力热力学极限的普适存在性，并处理有限多个二值模式与高斯型混合模型之间的联系。
AI.method: 利用 Hubbard–Stratonovich 表示提取隐藏坐标超过 δ√N 的有限多个模式；通过集体插值将其余二值模式替换为高斯模式，得到体积一致的 O(δ^2) 误差；用离散立方体上的凸集中控制依赖无序的保留模式选择。对混合模型证明体积一致且对任意 Ising 势成立的 Gaussian 隐藏自旋截断界，并将具有有限多种位点场类型的高斯 bulk 收敛性化归到 Ho 及 Chen–Ho–Issa 关于紧自旋非凸矢量自旋玻璃的结果。
AI.result: 证明淬火压力在任意载荷、有限逆温和均匀外场下存在热力学极限，极限为具有 r 个二值模式且高斯 bulk 的混合模型极限压力的上确界；压力具有指数小偏差概率并几乎必然收敛；在极限可微处内能和熵收敛。对 Gaussian 模式给出 Camilli–Contucci–Mingione 存在性结果的替代证明，并推广到均匀外场和额外二值模式。额外二值 Mattis 模式可化为标量变分问题；零场下 Rademacher 压力支配带额外二值模式的高斯压力，后者支配纯高斯压力。
AI.conclusion: 文章建立了 Hopfield 模型淬火压力热力学极限的广泛存在性，无需复制对称性、序参量集中或非凝聚假设，并给出与混合模型及高斯自旋玻璃结果的联系和若干压力比较；但未给出显式公式。作者说明证明是在与 Claude（Opus 5.5）和 ChatGPT（Sol 6.1）大量交互下、基于作者的问题表述与指导下生成的。

title: Agentic Global Optimization of Site-Disordered Crystalline Materials
summary: Site-disordered crystals, in which several elements partially occupy the same atomic site, cannot be simulated atomistically without first resolving an explicit ordering, and the number of possible orderings grows combinatorially with supercell size. Because each candidate requires an expensive structural relaxation, locating the global-minimum ordering is a costly combinatorial search. Here, we present an agentic search in which a surrogate model, fitted to previously evaluated configurations, selects each subsequent candidate by balancing exploitation, uncertainty, and novelty. Four surrogates are implemented within a shared framework: an ExtraTrees ensemble, Bayesian ridge regression, sparse ARD regression, and an ALiEGNN-inspired graph ensemble. These are benchmarked against three traditional methods: random walk, Markov chain Monte Carlo, and a genetic algorithm across 14 test cases spanning 12 crystal structures, with exhaustively enumerated global minima as ground truth. The agentic surrogates reach the global minimum in 94% of runs, compared with 55% for the traditional methods, with a median 4.3-fold reduction in evaluations relative to the best traditional method. Bayesian ridge regression succeeds in all runs with the fewest evaluations. Applied to Na2/3FePO4, with coupled Na/vacancy configurational disorder and Fe2+/Fe3+ charge disorder, the framework recovers the experimentally reported ordering when charge states are encoded in the surrogate representation, demonstrating its extension to multi-sublattice disorder.

AI.tldr: 提出一种代理模型驱动的智能搜索框架，用于高效寻找位点无序晶体的全局最低能有序构型，并在14个测试案例中显著优于传统搜索方法。
AI.motivation: 位点无序晶体中多个元素部分占据同一原子位点，若不做显式有序化解析就无法进行原子尺度模拟；候选有序构型数量随超胞尺寸组合爆炸，且每个候选都需昂贵结构弛豫，因此寻找全局最低能有序构型是 costly combinatorial search。
AI.method: 构建共享框架下的 agentic search：代理模型基于已评估构型选择下一个候选，并平衡利用、不确定性和新颖性。实现四种代理模型：ExtraTrees 集成、Bayesian ridge regression、稀疏 ARD 回归和受 ALiEGNN 启发的图集成；与随机游走、Markov chain Monte Carlo 和遗传算法在14个测试案例、12种晶体结构上基准比较，并以穷举全局最小值为 ground truth；进一步应用于具有 Na/空位构型无序和 Fe2+/Fe3+ 电荷无序的 Na2/3FePO4。
AI.result: 代理模型智能搜索在94%的运行中达到全局最小值，传统方法为55%；相对最佳传统方法，评估次数中位数减少4.3倍。Bayesian ridge regression在所有运行中均成功且评估次数最少。在 Na2/3FePO4 中，当代理表示编码电荷态时，框架恢复了实验报道的有序构型，证明可扩展到多子晶格无序。
AI.conclusion: 代理模型引导的智能搜索能以更少的结构弛豫高效、稳健地定位位点无序晶体的全局最低能有序构型，并可处理耦合构型无序与电荷无序的多子晶格问题。

title: Characterization of Phase Transitions with the Annealed Importance Sampling Algorithm
summary: We We explore the use of the Annealed Importance Sampling (AIS) algorithm as a numerical tool to study phase transitions and critical phenomena. By mapping physical systems such as Ising and spin-glass models directly onto Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), and extending the analysis to both synthetic and trained architectures, we use a unified RBM framework to compare the performance of AIS against standard Monte Carlo methods in regimes characterized by strong fluctuations and complex energy landscapes. The unified RBM formulation allows for massively parallel sampling, offering a scalable and precise alternative to traditional Monte Carlo methods. Building on a simple, heuristic mean-field AIS initialization derived from the weights of the network, the proposed scheme enhances sampling efficiency and accuracy across all systems considered, proving its effectiveness as a tool to detect and characterize phase transitions in discrete spin and spin-like systems. Our results show that a properly initialized AIS reliably estimates thermodynamic observables, including the partition function and magnetization, while accurately detecting both paramagnetic-ferromagnetic and paramagnetic-spin-glass phase transitions across various system sizes.

AI.tldr: 该文将Ising与自旋玻璃模型映射到受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM），提出基于网络权重的启发式平均场AIS初始化，并验证退火重要性采样（AIS）可作为研究相变与临界现象的高效数值工具。
AI.motivation: 相变与临界现象在强涨落和复杂能量景观下难以用传统蒙特卡洛方法高效、准确研究；作者希望利用RBM的统一框架实现大规模并行采样，并比较AIS与标准蒙特卡洛方法的性能。
AI.method: 将Ising和自旋玻璃等物理系统直接映射为RBM，并扩展到合成与训练后的RBM架构；提出由网络权重导出的简单启发式平均场AIS初始化方案；在统一RBM框架下用AIS估计配分函数、磁化强度等热力学观测量，并检测顺磁-铁磁和顺磁-自旋玻璃相变。
AI.result: 经过适当初始化的AIS在所有考察系统中提升了采样效率与精度，能够可靠估计配分函数和磁化强度等热力学观测量，并在不同系统尺寸下准确检测顺磁-铁磁与顺磁-自旋玻璃相变。
AI.conclusion: AIS结合RBM映射与平均场初始化，是一种可扩展、精确且有效的数值工具，可用于离散自旋及类自旋系统中的相变检测与表征。

title: Co--dsorption of terrylene and tetrapentacontane on hexagonal boron nitride - towards a two-dimensional Shpolskii matrix
summary: Organic molecular emitters are promising building blocks for quantum technologies, but their use at two-dimensional interfaces is limited by diffusion, aggregation, and photobleaching. We present work towards constructing an ultrathin two-dimensional Shpolskii-like host-guest matrix on hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) by co-depositing terrylene fluorophores with the long-chain tetrapentacontane in a solution-phase process. We demonstrate that this approach disperses terrylene in a roughly one-nanometer-thin alkane layer without detectable phase separation and allows tuning the emitter density from ensembles to isolated emitters showing characteristic blinking behavior consistent with single-molecule fluorescence. Time-lapse confocal microscopy, autocorrelation analysis, and fluorescence recovery after photobleaching show that suppressed diffusion and stable emitter positions can be achieved in several samples with a tetrapentacontane matrix. Encapsulation with hBN from the top side further improves photostability, with emitters demonstrating long lifetimes despite high photon doses. Successful co-adsorption of isolated emitters and alkane matrix is a milestone towards extending Shpolskii-type molecular isolation to hBN and provides a route towards stable, interface-integrated molecular qubits.

AI.tldr: 作者在六方氮化硼（hBN）上通过溶液相共沉积terrylene荧光分子与长链四十五烷，构建了约1纳米厚的Shpolskii型主客体基质，实现从系综到孤立单分子的可调发射体密度，并证明抑制扩散、稳定定位及顶部hBN封装提升光稳定性。
AI.motivation: 有机分子发射体是量子技术的有希望构建单元，但其在二维界面的应用受扩散、聚集和光漂白限制，因此需要一种能在hBN等二维界面上稳定分散和隔离分子发射体的方法。
AI.method: 采用溶液相共沉积工艺，将terrylene荧光团与长链tetrapentacontane共吸附到hBN上，形成超薄二维Shpolskii-like主客体矩阵；通过时间序列共聚焦显微、自相关分析和光漂白后荧光恢复（FRAP）评估扩散与定位稳定性，并采用顶部hBN封装测试光稳定性。
AI.result: terrylene被分散在约1纳米厚的烷烃层中且未检测到明显相分离；发射体密度可从系综调节至孤立单分子，孤立发射体表现出符合单分子荧光的特征闪烁行为；多个样品中四十五烷基质可实现扩散抑制和稳定发射体位置；顶部hBN封装进一步提高光稳定性，使发射体在高光子剂量下仍具有长寿命。
AI.conclusion: 孤立发射体与烷烃基质的成功共吸附是将Shpolskii型分子隔离扩展到hBN的重要里程碑，为稳定、界面集成的分子量子比特提供了途径。

title: Subsonic terahertz plasmon instability in space-time plasmonic crystals
summary: We investigate collective plasma-wave dynamics in a two-dimensional electron fluid subected to a travelling periodic modulation of the effective plasma velocity. Using a hydrodynamic description combined with Floquet-Bloch theory, we show that the travelling modulation acts as a moving plasmonic crystal whose band structure is governed by an effective drift velocity in the comoving frame. We demonstrate that the closure of the Bragg gap at the edge of the Brillouin zone gives rise to an exceptional point and triggers a Krein-type instability through the coupling of positive- and negative-energy modes. Analytical expressions are derived for the instability threshold and growth rate, revealing that self-amplification can occur even when the electron drift remains subsonic in the laboratory frame. Numerical simulations of the nonlinear hydrodynamic equations confirm the theoretical predictions and show the evolution towards a saturated regime dominated by a coherent Floquet-Bloch mode. These results identify travelling plasmonic crystals as a novel platform for wave amplification and non-Hermitian band dynamics in electronic fluids.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维电子流体在周期性行波调制的有效等离子体速度下的集体等离子体波动力学，揭示行波调制可作为移动的等离子体晶体，并通过Bragg带隙闭合与Krein型不稳定性实现亚声速漂移下的波自放大。
AI.motivation: 探索行波周期调制对电子流体中等离子体波集体动力学的影响，并寻找无需超声速电子漂移即可实现波放大与非厄米能带调控的机制。
AI.method: 采用流体动力学描述结合Floquet-Bloch理论分析移动等离子体晶体的能带结构；在共动坐标系中引入有效漂移速度，解析推导不稳定性阈值与增长率，并用非线性流体动力学方程数值模拟验证。
AI.result: 发现布里渊区边缘Bragg带隙闭合形成例外点，并通过正负能量模式耦合触发Krein型不稳定性；解析给出不稳定性阈值和增长率，表明即使实验室系中电子漂移保持亚声速也可发生自放大；数值模拟证实理论预测并显示系统趋于由相干Floquet-Bloch模式主导的饱和 regime。
AI.conclusion: 行波等离子体晶体是一种实现电子流体中波放大和非厄米能带动力学的新平台，且可在亚声速漂移条件下工作。

title: The spin-transfer inverse Faraday effect in Au/YIG thin film bilayers
summary: The inverse Faraday effect (IFE) (the generation of an effective magnetic field in a material upon irradiation with circularly polarized light) offers a pathway to ultrafast, non-thermal control of spin dynamics. In metallic/ferromagnetic-insulator (NM/FMI) bilayers, IFE-driven spin polarization in the metallic layer can be an alternative to generate magnon excitations in the magnetic insulator which otherwise would be inaccessible with photon energies below the insulator bandgap, but this avenue has remained mostly unexplored. In this work, we investigate the regime of spin-transfer via IFE in Au/YIG bilayers, by means of ultrafast time-resolved magneto-optical experiments. Understanding the mechanism of this spin-transfer IFE in these NM/FMI heterostructures is crucial for several reasons: it elucidates the fundamental coupling between light's angular momentum and collective spin modes at buried interfaces, it enables all-optical generation and manipulation of pure spin currents, and it paves the way toward THz-frequency spintronic devices leveraging the insulator's long magnon lifetimes.

AI.tldr: 利用超快时间分辨磁光实验研究Au/YIG双层中逆法拉第效应（IFE）驱动的自旋转移与磁振子激发机制。
AI.motivation: IFE可在材料中产生有效磁场，实现超快、非热自旋调控；在金属/铁磁绝缘体（NM/FMI）双层中，金属层内IFE诱导的自旋极化有望激发绝缘体中的磁振子，从而突破光子能量低于绝缘体带隙时无法直接激发磁振子的限制。
AI.method: 采用超快时间分辨磁光实验，研究Au/YIG双层中IFE诱导的自旋转移过程。
AI.result: 摘要主要提出并概述该研究思路，强调NM/FMI异质结构中IFE自旋转移机制此前大多未被探索；未给出具体定量实验结果或性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 理解该机制有助于揭示埋入界面处光角动量与集体自旋模的耦合、实现纯自旋流全光产生与操控，并推动利用绝缘体长磁振子寿命的THz自旋电子器件；但摘要未提供具体结论性数据。

title: Anisotropic Boltzmann transport in a tight-binding superlattice: Exact results for power-law energy-dependent scattering
summary: We develop a complete Boltzmann transport theory for the in-plane ($\sigma_{xx}$) and out-of-plane ($\sigma_{zz}$) conductivities of an electronic superlattice consisting of a periodic stack of two-dimensional (2D) parabolic-band layers coupled along the superlattice axis by nearest-neighbor tunneling $t$, in the physically relevant regime $t\ll E_F$ where the Fermi surface is an open, corrugated cylinder. Within the relaxation-time approximation with a power-law energy-dependent scattering time $\tau(E)\propto E^{p}$, we study the seven models $p=0,\pm1,\pm3/2,\pm2$ as functions of the 2D electron density $n$ per layer and temperature $T$. For $p=-2$ (in plane) and $p\le -1$ (out of plane), long-lived carriers at the miniband bottom can dominate transport at finite temperature. For $p=-2$, these carriers produce a pronounced peak in $\sigma_{zz}(T)$ at $T\sim E_F$. We find that the temperature dependence of the anisotropic metallic dc conductivity can be highly counterintuitive depending on $t$, $T$, and $p$, with no generic increase or decrease with temperature. The Lorenz ratio is determined by the energy variance of the current-carrying electrons; the Wiedemann-Franz (WF) law is exact as $T\to0$ for all models at fixed $t$, with anisotropic corrections at finite temperature. Band-edge carriers first enhance the interlayer Lorenz ratio up to several times its low-temperature value through thermal occupation of separated energy ranges within the same electron band and then suppress it at high temperature by energy filtering. Strong violations of the Wiedemann-Franz law can therefore arise from miniband structure and energy-dependent elastic scattering alone.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了电子超晶格的完整玻尔兹曼输运理论，计算层内σxx与层间σzz电导，揭示微带结构、能量相关弹性散射和温度如何共同导致反常金属输运及维德曼-弗兰兹定律违背。
AI.motivation: 针对由二维抛物带层沿超晶格轴通过最近邻隧穿t耦合、且在t≪E_F时具有开放波纹柱状费米面的体系，需要理解其各向异性直流电导、洛伦兹比及维德曼-弗兰兹定律在有限温度下的行为。
AI.method: 在弛豫时间近似下采用幂律能量依赖散射时间τ(E)∝E^p，系统研究p=0,±1,±3/2,±2七个模型；以每层二维电子密度n和温度T为变量，计算层内σxx与层间σzz，并分析洛伦兹比和WF定律修正。
AI.result: 发现p=-2（层内）及p≤-1（层间）时，微带底部长寿命载流子可在有限温度主导输运；p=-2时在T∼E_F处σzz(T)出现显著峰。各向异性金属dc电导的温度依赖高度反直觉，取决于t、T和p，并无普遍升降温趋势。洛伦兹比由载流电流电子的能量方差决定；固定t时所有模型在T→0严格满足WF定律，有限温度出现各向异性修正。带边载流子可先通过同一能带内分离能区的热占据使层间洛伦兹比升至低温值的数倍，后在高温因能量过滤而抑制。
AI.conclusion: 仅由微带结构和能量依赖弹性散射即可产生强维德曼-弗兰兹定律违背，超晶格输运不能以单一温度趋势或普适WF行为描述。

title: Quantum-Geometric Subgap Second-Harmonic Generation in PT-Symmetric Antiferromagnetic Insulators
summary: Although quantum geometry plays an established role in electronic transport and optical responses, the contribution of the time-reversal-odd Riemannian connection to fully subgap responses remains less explored. Here we identify intrinsic second-harmonic generation in PT-symmetric antiferromagnets, predominantly governed by the real sector of the interband Hermitian connection and arising entirely from virtual interband transitions. In bilayer MnBi$_2$Te$_4$, the response persists in trivial phases but is enhanced in the layer-Chern phase and reverses sign with N\'eel order, offering a probe of quantum geometry and phase-sensitive readout of antiferromagnetic order without mobile carriers or real excitations.

AI.tldr: 该文在PT对称反铁磁体中发现本征二次谐波产生，主要由带间厄米联络的实部支配并完全来自虚带间跃迁；在双层MnBi2Te4中，该响应在平庸相存在、在层陈相增强，并随奈尔序反号，可作为无需移动载流子或真实激发的量子几何探针和反铁磁序相敏读出。
AI.motivation: 量子几何已在电子输运和光学响应中确立作用，但时间反演奇的黎曼联络对完全亚带隙响应的贡献仍研究不足。
AI.method: 针对PT对称反铁磁体理论识别本征二次谐波产生，将其归因于带间厄米联络实部及虚带间跃迁；并以双层MnBi2Te4为平台比较平庸相、层陈相及奈尔序反转下的响应。
AI.result: 本征二次谐波产生在平庸相持续存在，在层陈相增强，并随奈尔序反转符号；该响应无需移动载流子或真实激发。
AI.conclusion: 工作揭示了时间反演奇量子几何与带间联络实部在亚带隙非线性光学中的作用，并提供反铁磁序的相敏光学读出与量子几何探测途径。

title: Berry curvature quadrupole induced third-order anomalous Hall effect in altermagnetic $\mathrm{KV_2Se_2O}$
summary: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, providing a symmetry-rich platform for exploring nonlinear quantum-geometric transport. In the d-wave altermagnet considered here, the antiunitary symmetry operation $TC_{4z}$ enforces a vanishing momentum-integrated Berry curvature, while inversion symmetry forbids a finite Berry-curvature dipole. Consequently, the Berry curvature quadrupole (BCQ) can provide a contribution to the nonlinear Hall response, scaling as $\tau^2$, where $\tau$ denotes the relaxation time. We derive a gauge-covariant Wannier interpolation formula that enables efficient evaluation of the BCQ directly from first-principles Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonians. Applying this framework to $\mathrm{KV_2Se_2O}$, we calculate the momentum-space distribution of the BCQ and the associated chemical potential dependent nonlinear conductivity. The momentum-resolved analysis reveals that the dominant contribution originates from spin-orbit coupling induced avoided arossings, directly linking the gap structure to the sign-changing nonlinear response. Our work establishes a general first-principles route to higher-order quantum-geometric responses in altermagnets, opening avenues for exploring nonlinear Hall effects in next-generation spintronic and magnetoelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 该文研究d波交错磁体中由Berry曲率四极矩（BCQ）驱动的非线性霍尔响应，并建立基于Wannier紧束缚模型的第一性原理计算方法，以KV2Se2O为例揭示其动量分辨的BCQ分布及符号变化的非线性电导。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体兼具补偿磁序与动量依赖的自旋劈裂，为非线性量子几何输运提供新平台；在特定对称性下常规Berry曲率及Berry曲率偶极矩受限，需寻找更高阶量子几何量对非线性霍尔效应的贡献。
AI.method: 针对d波交错磁体，利用TC4z反幺正对称性说明动量积分Berry曲率为零、反演对称性禁止Berry曲率偶极矩，从而聚焦按τ²标度的BCQ贡献；推导规范协变的Wannier插值公式，从第一性原理Wannier紧束缚哈密顿量高效计算BCQ，并应用于KV2Se2O。
AI.result: 计算得到KV2Se2O的动量空间BCQ分布及随化学势变化的非线性电导；动量分辨分析表明主导贡献来自自旋轨道耦合诱导的避免交叉，并将能隙结构与符号变化的非线性响应直接关联。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了交错磁体中高阶量子几何响应的通用第一性原理计算框架，为探索下一代自旋电子与磁电子器件中的非线性霍尔效应提供途径。

title: Spin-conserving and spin-flip magnetic scattering in the altermagnetic spin-splitter effect
summary: Critical magnetic fluctuations scatter electrons strongly near an ordering transition, but they barely degrade the charge current, because they scatter mostly through small angles. In an altermagnet the electric field also drives a spin current, and a nearly forward spin flip moves an electron to the other spin band at almost unchanged velocity. We develop a Boltzmann theory of the spin splitter ratio that keeps the full collision operator of quasistatic magnetic fluctuations and its change with the magnetic order. Fluctuations of equal total strength give the same resistivity for every fraction of spin flips, yet they can move the spin splitter ratio in opposite directions. Spin conserving fluctuations relax the spin current at about the charge relaxation rate, whereas forward flips equalize the two spin populations at equal energy at the quasiparticle rate, which in two dimensions grows linearly with the correlation length. Energy conservation on the split bands protects the part of the spin current carried by the band shift of the occupied states at every scattering strength, and the splitting blocks forward flips once the spin Fermi lines lie farther apart than the inverse correlation length. When flips dominate, a quarter to a half of the lattice band ratio survives. The transport time approximation reproduces the initial growth of the resistivity but recovers only a quarter to a half of the initial fall of the ratio, and a disorder series at fixed reduced temperature measures this fall independent of the order amplitude.

AI.tldr: 建立包含准静态磁涨落完整碰撞算符的Boltzmann理论，揭示altermagnet中自旋分裂比在电阻率相同的情况下可因自旋翻转比例不同而反向变化，并给出二维关联长度依赖及输运时间近似的失效范围。
AI.motivation: 临界磁涨落主要进行小角散射，对电荷电流削弱很小；但在altermagnet中电场也驱动自旋流，近前向自旋翻转几乎不改变速度却将电子切换到另一自旋带，因此仅用电阻率无法刻画磁涨落对自旋输运的影响。
AI.method: 构建自旋分裂比的Boltzmann理论，保留准静态磁涨落的完整碰撞算符及其随磁序的变化；分析自旋守恒散射、前向自旋翻转、二维准粒子率、能带劈裂与关联长度条件，并与输运时间近似及固定约化温度下的无序级数比较。
AI.result: 等总强度涨落对任意自旋翻转比例给出相同电阻率，但可使自旋分裂比朝相反方向移动；自旋守恒涨落以接近电荷弛豫率的速率弛豫自旋流，前向翻转以准粒子率使等能两自旋布居均等，二维中该率随关联长度线性增长；能带劈裂保护由占据态能带移动携带的自旋流，当自旋费米线间距大于关联长度倒数时阻断前向翻转；翻转主导时仍保留1/4–1/2的晶格能带比；输运时间近似仅复现电阻率初始增长和自旋分裂比初始下降的1/4–1/2。
AI.conclusion: 磁涨落对altermagnet自旋输运的影响不能仅由电阻率描述；完整碰撞算符对自旋分裂比至关重要，输运时间近似不足，而固定约化温度下的无序级数可独立于序参量幅度测量该下降。

title: Spin conservation protects the altermagnetic spin-splitter current from critical scattering
summary: Near a magnetic transition, critical fluctuations scatter electrons strongly, but the charge current survives, because long wavelength fluctuations barely turn the electron velocity. In an altermagnet the electric field also drives a spin current, the spin splitter effect, and a nearly forward scattering event that flips spin moves an electron to the other spin band at almost unchanged velocity. We show that the spin current shares the protection of the charge current only when the fluctuations conserve spin. Solving the Boltzmann equation with the full collision operator, including its change with the magnetic order, we find that forward flips equalize the two spin populations at equal energy at the quasiparticle rate, which in two dimensions grows linearly with the correlation length, whereas spin conserving fluctuations relax the spin current at a rate comparable to the charge relaxation rate. Fluctuations with the same resistivity can thus move the spin splitter ratio in opposite directions. Energy conservation protects the part of the spin current that follows the band shift of the occupied states, and the splitting blocks forward flips once the spin Fermi lines lie farther apart than the inverse correlation length. A disorder series at fixed reduced temperature measures the initial fall of the ratio with the magnetic resistivity independent of the order amplitude, and the growth of this slope toward the transition identifies spin flip critical fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 该文研究交错磁体中临界磁涨落如何影响自旋流与自旋分束比：只有当涨落守恒自旋时，自旋流才像电荷流一样受到保护；前向自旋翻转会在准粒子速率上平衡两个自旋布居，并在二维中随关联长度线性增强。
AI.motivation: 在磁转变附近，临界涨落强烈散射电子，但长波涨落几乎不改变电子速度，因此电荷流仍可存活。交错磁体中电场还驱动自旋流（自旋分束效应），而近前向散射并翻转自旋的事件可在速度几乎不变的情况下把电子移到另一自旋带，因此需要厘清临界涨落对自旋流保护与自旋分束比的影響。
AI.method: 作者求解包含完整碰撞算符及其随磁序变化的Boltzmann方程，区分自旋守恒与自旋翻转涨落，分析前向自旋翻转、能量守恒、自旋费米线间距与关联长度对自旋流弛豫和自旋分束比的作用，并考虑固定约化温度下的无序序列测量。
AI.result: 前向自旋翻转以准粒子速率使等能量两个自旋布居趋于平衡，该速率在二维中随关联长度线性增长；自旋守恒涨落则以与电荷弛豫率相当的速率弛豫自旋流。相同电阻率的涨落可使自旋分束比向相反方向移动。能量守恒保护跟随占据态能带移动的那部分自旋流；当自旋费米线间距大于关联长度倒数时，能带分裂会阻断前向自旋翻转。固定约化温度的无序序列显示，自旋分束比随磁电阻率的初始下降与序参量幅度无关，而该斜率向转变点增长可识别自旋翻转临界涨落。
AI.conclusion: 临界涨落对自旋流的影响取决于其是否守恒自旋：自旋翻转涨落通过前向翻转有效混合自旋带并显著影响自旋分束比，而自旋守恒涨落对自旋流的弛豫接近电荷流。自旋分束比的磁电阻依赖及其趋近转变点的斜率增长可作为区分自旋翻转临界涨落的输运判据。

title: Potentials of individual atoms by convergent beam electron diffraction
summary: In convergent beam electron diffraction (CBED) on two-dimensional (2D) materials, the intensity distributions within the individual CBED spots map the local atomic arrangements within the probed region. In this study we demonstrate that the average intensities within the CBED spots essentially depend on the scattering parameters by a single atom, thus, offering the possibility of the direct measurement of such parameters. Scattering potential of an individual atom can be approximated by the Gaussian function and its parameters, the standard deviation and the maximal phase shift, can be recovered from the ratio of the intensities in the zero- and higher orders spots in CBED pattern. In order to demonstrate this, we simulated CBED patterns and extracted the atomic scattering parameters from such patterns. In the simulated examples, no weak phase object approximation is applied and the proposed method provides accurate results even for materials with large phase shifts up to 1.5 rad, as for example tungsten. The scattering parameters recovered from the experimental CBED patterns of graphene and twisted graphene-hBN structure show good agreement with the theoretically obtained values.

AI.tldr: 该研究证明会聚束电子衍射（CBED）斑内平均强度主要由单原子散射参数决定，并可从零阶与高阶斑强度比中直接提取原子散射势的高斯参数。
AI.motivation: 二维材料CBED斑内强度分布反映局部原子排列，但需要一种无需弱相位物体近似、可直接测量单原子散射参数的方法。
AI.method: 将单原子散射势近似为高斯函数，利用CBED零阶与高阶斑强度比恢复标准差和最大相移；通过模拟CBED图案提取参数，并在石墨烯及扭转石墨烯-hBN实验CBED图案中验证。
AI.result: 模拟中不采用弱相位物体近似，方法对最大相移达1.5 rad的材料（如钨）仍准确；石墨烯和扭转石墨烯-hBN实验提取的散射参数与理论值吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: CBED斑内平均强度可用于直接、准确地测量单原子散射势参数，为二维材料局部原子结构表征提供有效途径。

title: Hierarchy of Electromagnetic Gauge Field Quantum Geometries
summary: The conventional Bloch quantum geometric tensor (QGT) describes electric-dipole geometry for spatially uniform perturbations and vertical Bloch transitions. We develop a broader framework linking quantum geometry to local and nonlocal electromagnetic response in gauge-field space, placing this tensor within a hierarchy of electric and magnetic multipole quantum geometries. The intrinsic antisymmetric adiabatic response in every electromagnetic channel is a Berry curvature in the space of its conjugate fields. The field-dependent projector uniquely fixes the QGT for that channel, pairing the response curvature with a quantum metric. This construction extends to spatially nonuniform perturbations, whose finite momentum transfer induces nonvertical Bloch transitions. We explicitly construct the current--current QGT connecting Bloch states at $\mathbf{k}\pm\mathbf{q}/2$, providing a unified metric and curvature description of nonlocal current response. In the doubled Brillouin zone, tangential derivatives generate conventional momentum-space QGT multipoles, whereas normal derivatives connect finite-momentum geometry to uniform electric- and magnetic-multipole-pair QGTs. We derive this connection through second order in $\mathbf{q}$. The finite-momentum curvature governs the intrinsic nonlocal Hall response, while an inverse-frequency moment of symmetric optical absorption probes the index-symmetric metric sector.

AI.tldr: 该文将传统Bloch量子几何张量推广为描述局域与非局域电磁响应的多极量子几何层级，并构造有限动量流-流QGT以统一刻画非局域电流响应。
AI.motivation: 传统QGT基于空间均匀微扰和垂直Bloch跃迁，仅描述电偶极几何，无法涵盖有限动量转移引起的非垂直跃迁及磁多极等电磁响应通道。
AI.method: 在规范场空间中建立连接量子几何与电磁响应的框架，将QGT纳入电/磁多极量子几何层级；利用场依赖投影算符确定各通道的QGT，并以Berry曲率配对量子度规。进一步构造连接k±q/2 Bloch态的流-流QGT，在双倍布里渊区中通过切向与法向导数及q的二阶展开联系有限动量几何与均匀多极QGT。
AI.result: 得到电磁各通道中本征反对称绝热响应对应于共轭场空间Berry曲率；流-流QGT给出非局域电流响应的度规与曲率统一描述；双倍布里渊区切向导数生成动量空间QGT多极，法向导数在二阶q下连接有限动量几何与均匀电/磁多极对QGT；有限动量曲率支配本征非局域Hall响应，对称光吸收的逆频率矩探测指标对称度规部分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了超越传统电偶极QGT的统一量子几何框架，将局域/非局域电磁响应、非局域Hall效应和光吸收度规探测纳入同一多极量子几何层级。

title: Evaluating Instrument-Centered AI Agents for Table-Top Science Experiments
summary: Reliable evaluation of AI agents for table-top science experiments has remained elusive because live instruments are hard to reset and share at scale, while instrument statefulness and safety constraints complicate evaluation. We introduce instrMCP and q-devBench, an evaluation stack for instrument-centered AI agents in table-top experiments. instrMCP connects coding agents to scientific instruments through the Model Context Protocol, serving as the instrument-access harness. q-devBench reconstructs 37 real experimental tasks from condensed-matter physics as virtual QCoDeS instruments covering quantum electronic transport, scanning probe imaging, and calibration workflows. q-devBench exposes reproducible failure modes in laboratory-agent systems while preserving realistic instrument-control workflows. Across a range of commercial coding-agent configurations, current systems already show substantial operational competence, satisfying 70-83% of measurement-related rubric criteria. The main bottleneck is scientific analysis, where performance falls to 28-46%. In an analysis-only ablation in which agents receive clean reference datasets without running the virtual measurement session, analysis performance improves substantially, closing roughly two thirds of the difference between the measurement and analysis scores. This suggests that much of the deficit arises from the measurement-session context, including tool-use overhead, longer context, measurement-planning decisions, and possible acquisition errors, while a residual scientific-reasoning gap remains. Together, instrMCP and q-devBench provide a practical sandbox for benchmarking, diagnosing, and improving laboratory AI harnesses, and establish a route from controlled virtual evaluation to future live-hardware validation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 instrMCP 与 q-devBench 评估栈，用虚拟 QCoDeS 仪器对桌面科学实验中的 AI 智能体进行可复现评测，覆盖测量执行与科学分析能力。
AI.motivation: 真实仪器难以大规模重置和共享，且仪器有状态性与安全约束，导致桌面科学实验 AI 智能体缺乏可靠评估。
AI.method: instrMCP 通过 Model Context Protocol 将编码智能体连接到科学仪器，作为仪器访问测试框架；q-devBench 将 37 个凝聚态物理真实实验任务重建为虚拟 QCoDeS 仪器任务，涵盖量子电子输运、扫描探针成像和校准流程。
AI.result: 商用编码智能体配置在测量相关评分标准上已达 70-83%，但科学分析仅 28-46%；在仅分析消融中，提供干净参考数据而不运行虚拟测量会话可显著提升分析表现，缩小测量与分析分数差距约三分之二。
AI.conclusion: 分析瓶颈主要来自测量会话上下文，包括工具使用开销、更长上下文、测量规划决策和潜在采集错误，同时仍存在残余科学推理差距；该评估栈可作为实验室 AI 框架的基准、诊断与改进沙箱，并为未来真实硬件验证提供路径。

title: Dipolar Exciton Polarons in a van der Waals Homobilayer
summary: Fermi polarons exemplify how many-body interactions give rise to emergent quasiparticles, providing a fundamental framework for understanding interacting quantum matter. In electron-doped two-dimensional semiconductors, exciton polarons offer optical access to Fermi-polaron physics and electrical tunability, yet achieving stronger and more controllable exciton-electron interactions remains a key challenge. Here, we realize dipolar exciton polarons in an electrically tunable van der Waals homobilayer, where interlayer excitons with spatially separated electrons and holes act as quantum impurities carrying permanent electric dipole moments. These dipolar polarons exhibit substantially enhanced exciton-electron interactions, with binding energies more than four times those of conventional intralayer exciton polarons. We further demonstrate that Fermi-sea layer polarization provides an additional degree of freedom for controlling many-body interactions. In particular, the presence of a Fermi sea induces hybridization between oppositely oriented dipolar polarons, whereas confining the Fermi sea to a single layer suppresses this hybridization and produces orientation-selective many-body dressing. Our findings establish an experimental platform for dipolar-polaron physics in which dipole orientation and Fermi-sea layer polarization jointly govern many-body interactions, opening a route towards electrically tunable interactions and dipolar-polaron-mediated attraction between itinerant electrons.

AI.tldr: 该文在电可调范德华同质双层中实现偶极激子极化子，利用层间激子的永久电偶极增强激子-电子相互作用，并通过费米海层极化调控多体杂化与选择性 dressing。
AI.motivation: 二维半导体中的激子极化子可光学访问费米极化子物理并具电可调性，但如何获得更强、更可控的激子-电子相互作用仍是关键挑战。
AI.method: 构建电可调范德华同质双层，使电子与空穴空间分离的层间激子作为携带永久电偶极矩的量子杂质；测量偶极极化子的激子-电子相互作用，并改变费米海所在层以调控多体相互作用。
AI.result: 偶极激子极化子的结合能超过常规层内激子极化子的四倍；费米海存在时，相反取向的偶极极化子发生杂化，而将费米海限制在单层可抑制该杂化并产生取向选择性的多体 dressing。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了由偶极取向与费米海层极化共同调控多体相互作用的偶极极化子实验平台，为电可调相互作用及偶极极化子介导的巡游电子间吸引提供途径。

title: Andreev-Enhanced Conductance in a Bilayer Graphene Quantum Point Contact
summary: Quantum point contacts provide a platform for probing mode-dependent Andreev reflection. Here, we demonstrate Andreev-enhanced conductance in a gate-defined bilayer graphene quantum point contact coupled to a superconducting aluminum electrode. Electrostatic gating enables sequential mode occupation, verified by normal-state conductance quantization. In the superconducting state, the conductance is enhanced within the conductance plateaus, while the enhancement decreases between plateaus, consistent with the nonlinear transmission dependence of Andreev reflection. The enhancement yields effective transmission probabilities up to 0.9, and extends over a bias window of approximately 140 $\mu$V, which we associate with a proximity-induced superconducting gap, close to the gap of the aluminum film. For in-plane fields, the enhancement persists up to the critical field, and the bias window follows the spectral gap predicted by Abrikosov-Gor'kov theory. In contrast, perpendicular fields suppress the enhancement approximately linearly from zero field, deviating from homogeneous pair breaking and indicative of flux penetration.

AI.tldr: 在门控双层石墨烯量子点接触与铝超导电极耦合体系中观测到安德烈夫增强电导，并揭示其随模式占据、偏压和磁场方向的依赖。
AI.motivation: 量子点接触可用于探测模式相关的安德烈夫反射；本文旨在研究双层石墨烯量子点接触中模式分辨的安德烈夫增强输运。
AI.method: 制备门定义双层石墨烯量子点接触并与超导铝电极耦合；利用静电门控实现顺序模式占据，并用正常态电导量子化验证；在超导态测量电导随门压、偏压及面内/垂直磁场的变化。
AI.result: 超导态下电导在量子化平台内增强、平台间减弱，符合安德烈夫反射的非线性透射依赖；有效透射率最高约0.9，增强偏压窗口约140 μV，对应接近铝膜能隙的邻近诱导超导能隙。面内磁场中增强持续至临界场，偏压窗口遵循Abrikosov-Gor'kov理论谱隙；垂直磁场则使增强从零场近似线性抑制，偏离均匀配对破缺，指示磁通穿透。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明双层石墨烯量子点接触可实现安德烈夫增强电导和模式相关安德烈夫反射；磁场各向异性揭示了邻近诱导超导能隙及垂直场下的磁通穿透效应。

title: Observation of light-induced Haldane gap in graphene
summary: Symmetry and topology, encoded in electronic wavefunctions, play a central role in the electronic properties and emergent phenomena of quantum materials. While these properties are conventionally determined by the equilibrium Hamiltonian, strong optical fields offer a fundamentally different route by reshaping the Hamiltonian on ultrafast timescales, turning symmetry and topology into dynamically controllable degrees of freedom. Graphene provides a paradigmatic platform for realizing this concept, where circularly polarized light has long been predicted to dynamically break time-reversal symmetry (TRS) and open a topologically nontrivial gap at the Dirac point. Despite extensive experimental efforts, direct observation of this Dirac gap-the defining spectroscopic signature of the dynamical TRS-breaking induced topological phase-has remained missing. Here we directly observe this light-induced Dirac gap in monolayer graphene. Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals that the gap emerges simultaneously with the optical field and exclusively under circularly polarized driving, directly linking its opening to dynamical TRS breaking. Together with Floquet theory, we identify the gap with a light-induced Haldane mass and reveal the associated nontrivial Floquet Berry curvature and Chern topology. By demonstrating dynamical TRS breaking in a prototypical non-magnetic material, our results establish optical driving as a route to ultrafast engineering of symmetry and topology, opening opportunities for dynamically tunable quantum matter beyond equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱在单层石墨烯中直接观测到圆偏振光诱导的狄拉克能隙，并将其归因于动态时间反演对称性破缺及Floquet Haldane质量。
AI.motivation: 对称性和拓扑通常由平衡态哈密顿量决定，而强光场可在超快时间尺度上重塑哈密顿量，使对称性和拓扑成为可动态调控的自由度；石墨烯中圆偏振光诱导拓扑能隙虽有长期理论预言，但直接谱学观测一直缺失。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨与角分辨光电子能谱（tr-ARPES）直接探测单层石墨烯在光场驱动下的电子能带，并结合Floquet理论分析能隙来源、Floquet贝里曲率及陈拓扑。
AI.result: 实验发现狄拉克能隙与光场同时出现，且仅在圆偏振驱动下打开，表明其源于动态时间反演对称性破缺；理论分析将其识别为光诱导的Haldane质量，并揭示非平庸的Floquet贝里曲率和陈拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 该研究在原型非磁性材料中实现了动态时间反演对称性破缺，确立了光驱动作为超快调控对称性与拓扑的手段，为构建超越平衡态的 Dynamically tunable quantum matter 提供了途径。

title: Moir\'e metals and continuum models beyond a single valley
summary: We derive continuum models of moir\'e materials valid over the full monolayer Brillouin zone, as required for metals whose large Fermi surfaces are not confined to a single valley. To this end, we introduce an environment-resolved two-center approximation, in which each hopping amplitude depends not only on the distance between the orbitals it connects but also on its position within the moir\'e cell. Taking the local environment to be set by the disregistry of the two layers alone, these moir\'e couplings and their full set of harmonics can be learnt from commensurate bilayers at uniform stackings, without fitting. The method shows excellent agreement with ab initio band structures on moir\'e cells containing a few hundred atoms. Applied to twisted NbSe$_2$, it yields a continuum model in which moir\'e effects concentrate at the van Hove singularities, a single-particle starting point for studying moir\'e-tuned superconducting, charge-density-wave instabilities and their competition.

AI.tldr: 提出环境分辨双中心近似，从均匀堆垛公度双层无拟合学习莫尔耦合，构建覆盖整个单层布里渊区的连续模型，并在扭转NbSe2中揭示莫尔效应集中于范霍夫奇点。
AI.motivation: 现有莫尔连续模型多局限于单谷或小费米面，难以描述费米面跨越多个谷、需要全布里渊区有效性的金属体系。
AI.method: 引入环境分辨的双中心近似，使跃迁振幅同时依赖轨道间距及其在莫尔胞内的位置；以两层错位定义局域环境，从均匀堆垛的公度双层中无拟合提取莫尔耦合及其全部谐波，并与数百原子莫尔胞的从头算能带比较。
AI.result: 该方法与从头算能带结构在数百原子莫尔胞上高度一致；应用于扭转NbSe2得到连续模型，显示莫尔效应主要集中在范霍夫奇点。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为研究莫尔调控的超导、电荷密度波不稳定性及其竞争提供单粒子起点，并适用于费米面不局限于单谷的金属莫尔材料。

title: Pair density waves via interband pairing --- a perspective from superfluid weight
summary: Pair density waves (PDW) are superconducting states that exhibit a spatially modulated pairing order parameter, corresponding to Cooper pairs carrying finite center-of-mass momentum. While some recent studies have emphasized the role of quantum geometry in stabilizing PDW order in certain multiband systems, we here present a systematic investigation of an alternative, geometry-independent mechanism: PDW order driven purely by interband Cooper pairing. Using the superfluid weight (SW) as a diagnostic, we study two canonical models. The first is the classic Fulde-Ferrell model of an $s$-wave superconductor subject to a Zeeman splitting field, which realizes pure interband pairing between two rigidly shifted bands; the second is a spinless honeycomb-lattice model with nearest-neighbor $f$-wave pairing, a modified version of which was recently found to exhibit PDW instability in density-matrix renormalization-group simulations. In both models the SW receives no quantum geometric contribution at the mean-field level, yet it can be greatly suppressed or even turn negative, signaling a tendency toward pairing with spatial phase modulations. For the first model, we establish that the SW is increasingly suppressed as the Zeeman field grows, drastically turning negative upon the emergence of extensive gapless excitations, i.e., the Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces. For the honeycomb $f$-wave model, we demonstrate, both analytically and numerically, vanishing quantum-geometric SW and an invariably negative total SW. Our results thus establish the SW as a qualitative indicator of the tendency toward PDW order, and provide a microscopic rationale for the interband-pairing-driven PDW instability.

AI.tldr: 该文系统研究一种不依赖量子几何的PDW机制：纯带间Cooper配对可通过显著压低甚至使超流权重变负来驱动空间调制配对。
AI.motivation: 近期部分工作强调量子几何在多带体系中稳定PDW序的作用，本文则考察另一种几何无关机制，即仅由带间Cooper配对驱动PDW不稳定性。
AI.method: 以超流权重（SW）作为诊断量，分析两个典型模型：受Zeeman场作用的s波Fulde-Ferrell模型（两刚性平移带间的纯带间配对），以及最近邻f波配对的无自旋蜂窝晶格模型。
AI.result: 两模型在平均场层面均无量子几何对SW的贡献，但SW可被大幅抑制甚至变负。FF模型中，随Zeeman场增强SW受抑，并在出现大量无能隙激发（Bogoliubov费米面）时急剧转负；蜂窝f波模型中，解析与数值均表明量子几何SW为零且总SW恒为负。
AI.conclusion: SW可作为PDW序倾向的定性指标，并为带间配对驱动的PDW不稳定性提供微观解释。

title: Creating functional nanostructures for vortex manipulation in superconducting Bi$_\text{2}$Sr$_\text{2}$CaCu$_\text{2}$O$_\text{8+x}$ thin films via focused He ion beam irradiation
summary: Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+x}$ (Bi-2212) is a highly anisotropic high-temperature superconductor exhibiting unique vortex dynamics due to its layered structure. Precise nanoscale patterning of ultrathin Bi-2212 films remains challenging, limiting controlled studies of vortex pinning. Here, we employ 30 keV focused helium ion beam (He-FIB) irradiation to fabricate periodic arrays of columnar defects with 100 nm spacings in optimally-doped Bi-2212 thin films, thereby creating artificial vortex pinning centers. Magnetotransport measurements reveal pronounced vortex matching effects, evidenced by minima in magnetoresistance and peaks in critical current at commensurate magnetic fields. The angular dependence of magnetoresistance and critical current scale with an effective magnetic field, indicating strong confinement of pancake vortices along irradiation-induced tracks. These findings demonstrate the efficacy of He-FIB nanopatterning in modulating the superconducting properties in Bi-2212 thin films, providing a platform for fundamental studies of vortex matter and advancing prospects for device applications based on this highly anisotropic superconductor.

AI.tldr: 利用30 keV聚焦氦离子束在优化掺杂Bi-2212薄膜中制备间距100 nm的周期性柱状缺陷阵列，诱导人工涡旋钉扎中心，并在磁输运中观察到显著的涡旋匹配效应。
AI.motivation: Bi-2212是高度各向异性的高温超导体，其层状结构导致独特涡旋动力学；但超薄Bi-2212薄膜的精确纳米图案化仍具挑战，限制了涡旋钉扎的可控研究。
AI.method: 采用30 keV聚焦氦离子束（He-FIB）辐照优化掺杂Bi-2212薄膜，制备间距100 nm的周期性柱状缺陷阵列作为人工钉扎中心；通过磁电阻和临界电流测量，并结合角度依赖分析研究涡旋匹配与 pancake 涡旋行为。
AI.result: 磁输运测量显示明显的涡旋匹配效应：在公度磁场下磁电阻出现极小值、临界电流出现峰值；磁电阻和临界电流的角度依赖可由有效磁场标度，表明 pancake 涡旋被强约束在辐照诱导的柱状轨迹附近。
AI.conclusion: He-FIB纳米图案化可有效调控Bi-2212薄膜的超导性质，为研究高度各向异性超导体中的涡旋物质提供平台，并推动相关器件应用。

title: Current-driven transient dynamics of magnetic-octupole domain walls in noncollinear antiferromagnets
summary: Current-driven magnetic-octupole domain walls in noncollinear antiferromagnets are promising for fast spintronic devices, yet their transient dynamics are not yet fully understood. Here, we investigate spin-orbit-torque-driven domain-wall motion in Mn$_\text{3}$Sn using a multipole micromagnetic framework. The three symmetry-related 60{\deg} walls exhibit equivalent current-driven dynamics, unlike their field-driven motion. For a representative 60{\deg} wall, the post-pulse motion is governed by relaxation of the current-induced rotation of the surrounding octupole domains, with a characteristic time of approximately 33 ps quantitatively captured by a uniform-domain analytic model. By resolving spatially nonuniform texture dynamics beyond this analytic description, the simulations further reveal an additional slow relaxation in a composite 180{\deg} wall associated with the relative motion of its constituent walls. The post-pulse response also varies systematically with the exchange stiffness and magnetic anisotropies. These results identify distinct domain and internal-coordinate relaxation channels and establish the intrinsic time scales governing pulse-controlled positioning of magnetic-octupole domain walls in antiferromagnetic spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 该文用多极微磁框架研究Mn3Sn中自旋轨道矩驱动的磁八极畴壁瞬态动力学，发现60°畴壁电流驱动响应等价，脉冲后运动由约33 ps的八极畴旋转弛豫主导，并揭示复合180°畴壁的额外慢弛豫通道。
AI.motivation: 电流驱动非共线反铁磁体中的磁八极畴壁有望用于快速自旋电子器件，但其瞬态动力学尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 采用多极微磁框架模拟Mn3Sn中自旋轨道矩驱动的畴壁运动；比较三个对称相关的60°畴壁，并用均匀畴解析模型分析代表性60°畴壁的脉冲后弛豫；进一步解析空间非均匀织构动力学，包括复合180°畴壁及交换刚度和磁各向异性的影响。
AI.result: 三个60°畴壁在电流驱动下具有等价动力学，而场驱动下不等价；代表性60°畴壁的脉冲后运动由周围八极畴中电流诱导旋转的弛豫主导，特征时间约33 ps，可由均匀畴解析模型定量描述；模拟还发现复合180°畴壁中存在与其组成畴壁相对运动相关的额外慢弛豫，且脉冲后响应随交换刚度和磁各向异性系统变化。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了畴与内部坐标两类弛豫通道，并确立了控制反铁磁自旋电子器件中磁八极畴壁脉冲定位的本征时间尺度。

title: SKFitter: Symmetry resolved Slater Koster tight-binding models from first principles for s, p, d and f electrons, spin orbit coupling and magnetism
summary: Constructing accurate and physically interpretable tight binding (TB) Hamiltonians from first principles calculations remains challenging, particularly for materials exhibiting complex orbital hybridization, spin orbit coupling (SOC), and magnetic order. SKFitter is an open-source Python framework for constructing and optimizing symmetry resolved Slater Koster TB models directly from density functional theory (DFT) calculations performed using Quantum ESPRESSO or VASP. The framework supports s to f orbitals, incorporates on site SOC and site resolved magnetic exchange interactions, and accommodates both orthogonal and nonorthogonal basis. A central feature is the symmetry resolved parameterization of orbital manifolds, which allows independent two centre hopping integrals between symmetry allowed orbital groups and across distinct neighbour shells. SKFitter also identifies missing orbital contributions and guide systematic basis set refinement and optimizes parameters through weights. The resulting Hamiltonian can be used to evaluate anomalous (AHC) and spin Hall conductivities (SHC), and topological invariants. We demonstrate the framework using eight representative materials spanning semimetals, semiconductors, transition metals, f-electron compounds, and magnetic systems. Symmetry resolved models achieve band energy errors of 9 to 41 meV within 1 eV of the Fermi level. The fitted Hamiltonians reproduce characteristic features of the SHC response of Pt, the SOC dependence of the AHC of Fe, and the momentum dependent altermagnetic spin splitting of MnTe without any altermagnet specific interaction. For EuMn2Bi2, projection guided orbital refinement reduces the near Fermi level fitting error from 120 to 32 meV. Together, these results establish SKFitter as a flexible and reproducible framework for developing symmetry consistent, physically interpretable TB models of complex materials.

AI.tldr: SKFitter 是一个从 DFT 构建并优化对称性分辨 Slater-Koster 紧束缚模型的开源 Python 框架，可处理 SOC、磁性交换及复杂轨道，并用于输运与拓扑性质计算。
AI.motivation: 从第一性原理构建准确且物理可解释的紧束缚哈密顿量仍很困难，尤其是涉及复杂轨道杂化、自旋轨道耦合和磁有序的材料。
AI.method: SKFitter 基于 Quantum ESPRESSO 或 VASP 的 DFT 结果，构建对称性分辨的 Slater-Koster 紧束缚模型，支持 s 到 f 轨道、在位 SOC、位点分辨磁交换、正交与非正交基组；通过对对称允许轨道组及不同近邻壳层间的两中心跃迁积分进行独立参数化，并利用权重优化参数，同时识别缺失轨道贡献以指导基组系统精炼。所得哈密顿量可用于计算反常霍尔电导、自旋霍尔电导和拓扑不变量。
AI.result: 在八种代表性材料（半金属、半导体、过渡金属、f 电子化合物和磁性体系）上验证，对称性分辨模型在费米能级 1 eV 内的能带误差为 9–41 meV；可重现 Pt 的自旋霍尔电导特征、Fe 中反常霍尔电导的 SOC 依赖性，以及 MnTe 的动量依赖交变磁自旋劈裂且无需交变磁专用相互作用；对 EuMn2Bi2，投影引导的轨道精炼将近费米能级拟合误差从 120 meV 降至 32 meV。
AI.conclusion: SKFitter 为复杂材料提供了一种灵活、可重复且对称性一致的紧束缚模型构建框架，生成的模型具有物理可解释性并可用于输运与拓扑性质研究。

title: Thermal Stability and Structural Relaxation Kinetics of Commercially Pure Titanium
summary:
This work explores the structural relaxation of cryorolled commercially pure titanium subjected to subsequent annealing.Nanostructured specimens with an average grain size of ~50 nm were produced by plastic deformation via cryogenic rolling at 100 K to a true strain of 1.20, followed by annealing at 425 K, 525 K, 725 K, and 945 K. Microstructural evolution was examined using electron microscopy and X-ray diffraction.
  Cryogenic rolling was found to induce pronounced grain fragmentation, with coherent scattering regions (CSRs) of 30-50 nm dominating the substructure. X-ray diffraction analysis revealed that annealing drives crystallite growth: a slight increase at 525 K, accelerated coarsening at 725 K, and complete recrystallization at 945 K. The kinetics of grain growth follow the classical Lifshitz-Slyozov-Wagner model, with a growth exponent of ~4, reflecting the role of triple junctions and defect-controlled boundary diffusion. The activation energy, estimated at ~97 kJ/mol, corresponds to typical values for grain boundary diffusion in {\alpha}-Ti, confirming that cryogenic deformation produces a highly non-equilibrium microstructure whose relaxation is strongly temperature dependent.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了商业纯钛经深冷轧制及后续退火后的结构弛豫与晶粒长大行为。
AI.motivation: 深冷塑性变形可制备纳米结构金属，但其非平衡显微结构在退火过程中的弛豫机制和晶粒长大动力学仍需阐明。
AI.method: 将商业纯钛在100 K深冷轧制至真应变1.20，获得平均晶粒约50 nm的纳米结构，随后在425、525、725和945 K退火，并利用电子显微术和X射线衍射表征组织演化。
AI.result: 深冷轧制导致显著晶粒碎裂，30–50 nm的相干散射区主导亚结构；退火时晶粒在525 K轻微长大、725 K加速粗化、945 K完全再结晶。晶粒长大符合Lifshitz–Slyozov–Wagner模型，生长指数约4，表明三叉晶界和缺陷控制晶界扩散起作用；激活能约97 kJ/mol，与α-Ti晶界扩散典型值相符。
AI.conclusion: 深冷变形使纯钛形成高度非平衡显微结构，其退火弛豫和晶粒长大强烈依赖温度，并由晶界扩散及缺陷/三叉晶界相关机制控制。

title: Spectral properties of orthorhombic KSbOSiO$_4$ crystals: studies of infrared, visible and ultraviolet radiation absorption, Raman scattering, cathodoluminescence and photoluminescence
summary: Crystals of orthorhombic KSbOSiO$_4$ (KSS) are often found to synthesize in glass of historical and artistic articles. For instance, these crystallites in the glass of turquoise Bohemian seed beads are known to play a significant role in the process of internal-stress driven corrosion of the glass causing deterioration and destruction of bead embroidered museum exhibits, especially articles made in the early 19th century. In art materials science, KSS has been known since the mid-2010s only for its destructive effects on historical glass objects, but as an optical material it has long been studied. KSS belongs to the group of compounds isomorphic to KTiOPO$_4$ (KTP) and, like other compounds from this group, has anomalies in dielectric constant. The article presents the results of a study of orthorhombic KSS crystals using a number of spectroscopic techniques. IR absorption and diffuse reflection spectra of KSS in the spectral range from 50 to 4000~cm$^{-1}$, its Raman spectrum, its absorption spectrum in the range from near infrared to ultraviolet as well as its cathodoluminescence and photoluminescence spectra are investigated. The constituent peaks of the spectral bands are analyzed and their properties are summarized in tables; the allowed direct and indirect band gaps of KSS are determined. The presented data are necessary both for the correct spectral analysis of historical and artistic glass and enamels, during the production of which this substance was sometimes synthesized in glass, and for a more in-depth study of crystals of the KTP group.

AI.tldr: 该文系统表征了正交相 KSbOSiO$_4$（KSS）晶体的红外、拉曼、紫外-可见-近红外吸收、阴极发光和光致发光光谱，并确定了其直接与间接带隙。
AI.motivation: KSS 晶体常生成于历史与艺术玻璃中，尤其在波希米亚绿松石色籽珠中会引发内应力驱动的玻璃腐蚀，导致博物馆藏品劣化；同时 KSS 属于 KTiOPO$_4$（KTP）同构体系，具有介电常数异常，需要更深入的光谱与光学基础数据。
AI.method: 采用多种光谱技术研究正交相 KSS 晶体：测量 50–4000 cm$^{-1}$ 的红外吸收与漫反射光谱、拉曼光谱、近红外至紫外吸收光谱，以及阴极发光和光致发光光谱；分析光谱带的组成峰并用表格总结性质。
AI.result: 解析了 KSS 各光谱谱带的组成峰及其特征，汇总于表格，并确定了 KSS 的允许直接带隙和间接带隙。
AI.conclusion: 所获光谱与带隙数据既可用于含 KSS 的历史和艺术玻璃及釉层的正确光谱分析，也为 KTP 族晶体的进一步研究提供了基础参考。

title: Kibble-Zurek dynamics beyond the thermodynamic limit
summary: The Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM) predicts the universal scaling of topological defect densities generated during continuous phase transitions, a result derived in the thermodynamic limit of homogeneous systems. Yet real materials are intrinsically finite and heterogeneous, raising the question of how nonequilibrium universality survives outside this idealized limit. Here we establish an ensemble-finite-size extension of the KZM that describes critical dynamics in collections of independent finite subsystems with distributed sizes. We test this framework using a polycrystalline model system undergoing a symmetry-breaking transition. We find that the density of topological vortices follows an apparent power law with an exponent approximately half that observed in single crystals. This reduced exponent emerges quantitatively from averaging over the experimentally measured grain-size distribution, without fitting to the measured vortex densities. Our results demonstrate that finite-size effects do not simply suppress KZ scaling but reorganize it into an emergent statistical scaling regime governed by system-size heterogeneity. This establishes microstructure and geometry as control parameters of nonequilibrium critical dynamics and provides a general strategy to engineer scaling behaviour in complex materials.

AI.tldr: 该文提出KZM的集合有限尺寸扩展，解释异质有限子系统中缺陷密度如何呈现由尺寸分布支配的涌现标度。
AI.motivation: 传统Kibble-Zurek机制在热力学极限和均匀系统中导出普适缺陷标度，但真实材料有限且异质，因此需回答非平衡普适性如何在理想极限之外存续。
AI.method: 作者构建适用于大量独立有限子系统且尺寸服从分布的集合有限尺寸KZM框架，并在发生对称破缺转变的多晶模型系统中检验；将涡旋密度标度与实验测得的晶粒尺寸分布平均结果比较，且不对实测涡旋密度拟合。
AI.result: 拓扑涡旋密度表现为表观幂律，其指数约为单晶情形的一半；该减小指数可由实验晶粒尺寸分布的 averaging 定量解释。
AI.conclusion: 有限尺寸效应并非简单抑制KZ标度，而是将其重组为由系统尺寸异质性支配的涌现统计标度 regime；微结构和几何因此成为非平衡临界动力学的控制参数，并为复杂材料中标度行为工程化提供一般策略。

title: Cavity-engineered ferroelectricity in SrTiO$_3$
summary: Interfacing quantum materials with photonic cavity architectures is at the vanguard of materials engineering. The structured electromagnetic fluctuations of a dark cavity environment can renormalize fundamental thermodynamical material properties and energy scales, holding promise to create a rich ecosystem of cavity-induced ground states and functionalities absent in the bare material. However, direct experimental demonstrations that cavity coupling can stabilize or enhance genuinely new phases of matter have remained scarce. In this work, we establish the presence of cavity-induced and cavity-enhanced ferroelectric phases in free-standing SrTiO$_3$ membranes coupled to dark THz-frequency photonic crystal cavities. Using THz spectroscopy, we observe ultrastrong coupling (USC) between the ferroelectric soft mode in SrTiO$_3$ and the cavity resonance. The structural response of SrTiO$_3$ to this USC is measured via second harmonic generation imaging, which reveals a substantial (greater than 400%) enhancement of signal in the cavity environment and a distinct modification of the crystalline symmetry, indicating the onset and enhancement of ferroelectricity. We interpret these observations as resulting from renormalized piezoelectric and flexoelectric couplings, which in turn arise from the cavity-modified dielectric environment. This interpretation is supported with microscopic modeling via DFT-based multi-scale dynamics simulations and by macroscopic Ginzburg-Landau theory. Altogether, our experimental and theoretical results firmly confirm that cavity engineering can indeed be used to create new ground states in materials and enhance existing ones. This work establishes a new paradigm for materials engineering with direct applications for quantum transduction, quantum sensing, and nonlinear integrated photonics.

AI.tldr: 该工作将自支撑SrTiO3薄膜与暗态THz光子晶体腔耦合，观察到铁电软模与腔共振的超强耦合，并实现腔诱导及腔增强的铁电相。
AI.motivation: 暗腔环境的电磁涨落可重整材料热力学性质与能标，但实验上证明腔耦合能稳定或增强新物相仍很稀缺。
AI.method: 采用THz光谱测量SrTiO3软模与腔共振的耦合；用二次谐波产生成像表征结构响应；结合DFT多尺度动力学模拟与宏观Ginzburg-Landau理论解释机制。
AI.result: 观察到超强耦合；二次谐波信号增强超过400%且晶格对称性发生明显改变，表明铁电性出现并被增强；其机制归因于腔修饰介电环境导致的压电与挠曲电耦合重整化。
AI.conclusion: 实验与理论共同确认腔工程可创造新材料基态并增强已有基态，为量子转导、量子传感和非线性集成光子学提供新范式。

title: Anisotropic spin splitting in $\alpha$-MnTe epilayers on InP(111)A and Si(111) substrates
summary: $\alpha$-MnTe has emerged as a prototypical altermagnetic material, combining compensated antiferromagnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting. Here, we investigate the structural and electronic properties of epitaxial $\alpha$-MnTe layers grown by molecular beam epitaxy on InP(111)A and Si(111) substrates. The crystalline and surface quality of the epilayers was characterised by reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED), atomic force microscopy (AFM), and X-ray diffraction (XRD), confirming the formation of high-quality, single-phase films. The transport measurements were performed, confirming an antiferromagnetic transition and weak ferromagnetism. The electronic structure was studied using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). At 90 K, both samples exhibit relativistic anisotropic valence band splitting, which is substantially larger along the $\Gamma$-K direction, reaching approximately 300 meV, than along $\Gamma$-M, where values of about 150~meV are observed. The magnitude and momentum dependence of the splitting are very similar for $\alpha$-MnTe grown on the two different substrates, indicating the robustness of the altermagnetic electronic structure with respect to the epitaxial environment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了分子束外延生长的α-MnTe外延层的结构与电子性质，并通过ARPES观察到沿Γ-K方向约300 meV、沿Γ-M方向约150 meV的相对论性各向异性价带劈裂，且该劈裂对衬底环境不敏感。
AI.motivation: α-MnTe是典型交替磁体，兼具补偿反铁磁序与动量依赖自旋劈裂；作者希望阐明外延生长α-MnTe的结构与电子性质，并检验其交替磁电子结构是否受外延衬底环境影响。
AI.method: 采用分子束外延在InP(111)A和Si(111)衬底上生长α-MnTe薄膜；用RHEED、AFM和XRD表征晶体与表面质量，用输运测量确认反铁磁转变和弱铁磁性，并用角分辨光电子能谱研究电子结构。
AI.result: 薄膜为高质量单相外延层；输运测量确认反铁磁转变和弱铁磁性；90 K下两种样品均表现出相对论性各向异性价带劈裂，Γ-K方向约300 meV，显著大于Γ-M方向约150 meV；不同衬底上α-MnTe的劈裂大小与动量依赖关系非常相似。
AI.conclusion: α-MnTe的交替磁电子结构对外延环境具有鲁棒性，其各向异性价带劈裂是材料本征特征而非衬底诱导效应。

title: Intertwined ferromagnetic and altermagnetic orders in Cr-doped MnTe
summary: Ferromagnetism and altermagnetism both break time-reversal symmetry, yet their distinct transformation properties under crystalline symmetries forbid direct bilinear coupling between their order parameters. Whether these two magnetic orders can remain thermodynamically distinct while strongly influencing one another remains an open question. Here we demonstrate the homogeneous coexistence of ferromagnetism and altermagnetism in Cr-doped MnTe. By tuning the ferromagnetic ordering temperature across the nearly unchanged N\'eel temperature with Cr doping, we uncover a striking interplay between the two orders: the ferromagnetic transition becomes a crossover when altermagnetism develops first, whereas the onset of altermagnetism strongly suppresses the out-of-plane ferromagnetic remanence when ferromagnetism develops first. Moreover, spin-orbit coupling enables symmetry-selective interactions through which the ferromagnetic moment controls the altermagnetic domain manifold, with its out-of-plane and in-plane components biasing the time-reversal ($Z_2$) and orientational ($Z_3$) sectors, respectively. Our results reveal how two symmetry-distinct magnetic orders can retain separate ordering tendencies while remaining strongly coupled, providing a route towards internal control of altermagnetic domain states.

AI.tldr: 在Cr掺杂MnTe中实现铁磁与交错磁（altermagnetism）均匀共存，并揭示两种对称性不同、无直接双线性耦合的磁序之间仍可强耦合：先发生的交错磁使铁磁转变变为crossovers，先发生的铁磁则其面外剩磁被交错磁抑制；自旋轨道耦合使铁磁矩分别偏向交错磁畴的Z2与Z3扇区。
AI.motivation: 铁磁与交错磁均破缺时间反演对称性，但晶格对称性下的变换性质不同，禁止其序参量直接双线性耦合。二者能否在热力学上保持独立有序倾向的同时强烈相互影响，是未解问题。
AI.method: 通过Cr掺杂调节MnTe的铁磁有序温度，使其跨越几乎不变的Néel温度，从而改变两种磁序的出现顺序；结合磁测量与对称性分析研究铁磁转变性质、剩磁及交错磁畴态对铁磁矩方向的响应。
AI.result: 观察到铁磁与交错磁均匀共存。当交错磁先发展时，铁磁转变变为crossovers；当铁磁先发展时，交错磁起始强烈抑制面外铁磁剩磁。自旋轨道耦合诱导对称选择性相互作用，铁磁矩的面外和面内分量分别偏置交错磁畴的Z2（时间反演）和Z3（取向）扇区。
AI.conclusion: 两种对称性不同的磁序可保留各自有序倾向却仍强耦合；该机制提供了通过铁磁矩内部调控交错磁畴态的途径。

title: Efficient Simulation of Gate Leakage Currents in Ultra-scaled Transistors from First Principles
summary: To ensure high electrostatic integrity in ultra-scaled field-effect transistors (FETs), thin gate dielectric layers are typically needed, potentially giving rise to (strong) leakage currents. Being able to model this effect is therefore crucial. Here, we show how gate leakage currents can be computed at the ab initio level in WS$_2$-hBN FETs by extending the well-established quantum transmitting boundary method (QTBM). Two main challenges are tackled: (i) the calculation of the open boundary conditions (OBCs) for the gate contacts and (ii) the solution of the resulting sparse linear system of equations A x = b where the matrix A possesses an unstructured sparsity pattern. We demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state of the art and can be readily applied to simulate transistors with gate lengths exceeding 25 nm.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过扩展量子传输边界法（QTBM），在从头算层面计算WS2-hBN场效应晶体管的栅极漏电流，并解决了栅极接触开放边界条件与稀疏非结构矩阵线性系统求解两个关键问题。
AI.motivation: 超微缩FET需要薄栅介质以维持高静电完整性，但这会带来显著栅极漏电流，因此需要在ab initio层面准确建模该效应。
AI.method: 扩展成熟的量子传输边界法（QTBM）：(i) 计算栅极接触的开放边界条件（OBCs）；(ii) 求解具有非结构稀疏模式的稀疏线性方程组 Ax=b。
AI.result: 所提方法优于现有技术水平，并可模拟栅长超过25 nm的晶体管。
AI.conclusion: 该扩展QTBM方法能够有效地在ab initio层面模拟WS2-hBN FET的栅极漏电流，并具备面向较长栅长器件仿真的可扩展性。

title: Temperature Evolution of Magnon-Polarons in the van der Waals Antiferromagnet FePS$_3$
summary: Magnon polarons, hybrid excitations arising from magnon-phonon coupling, were investigated in the van der Waals antiferromagnet FePS3 using magneto-Raman scattering measurements at temperatures ranging from 4 K to the vicinity of the N\'eel temperature ($T_\mathrm{N}$ = 118 K). The lower Zeeman-split component of the magnon-like mode, tuned by the magnetic field toward the lower-energy phonon mode, exhibits an avoided crossing. The corresponding magnetic field decreases from approximately 13 T at 4 K to 5.6 T at 85 K, bringing the effect within reach of a standard laboratory magnet. A model of three coupled bosonic modes shows that the magnon-phonon coupling constant, approximately 2.7 cm$^{-1}$ at low temperatures, decreases significantly with increasing temperature, following a trend similar to the temperature-induced softening of the magnon mode. This decrease in magnon-phonon coupling is discussed in terms of a possible reduction in sublattice magnetization due to thermal fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用磁拉曼散射研究范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中的磁振子-声子杂化（磁振子极化子），观测到磁场诱导的避免交叉，并发现磁振子-声子耦合随温度显著减弱。
AI.motivation: 探究 FePS3 中磁振子与声子耦合形成的磁振子极化子，以及其磁场和温度可调性，尤其是耦合强度随温度变化的物理机制。
AI.method: 在 4 K 至奈尔温度附近（TN = 118 K）进行磁拉曼散射测量；通过磁场将较低 Zeeman 分裂的类磁振子模式调谐至低能声子模式；采用三耦合玻色子模式模型拟合避免交叉。
AI.result: 类磁振子模式的较低 Zeeman 分裂分量与低能声子发生避免交叉；对应磁场从 4 K 时约 13 T 降至 85 K 时 5.6 T。拟合得到低温磁振子-声子耦合常数约 2.7 cm^-1，并随温度升高显著减小，趋势类似磁振子模式的热软化。
AI.conclusion: FePS3 中磁振子-声子耦合具有明显温度依赖性，其减弱可能与热涨落导致亚晶格磁化强度降低有关。

title: 10 kV $\beta$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ Sub-Bandgap Triggered Impurity Photoconductive Semiconductor Switches (i-PCSSs): Lessons for Optimal Design
summary: $\beta$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ photoconductive semiconductor switches (PCSSs) are attractive for high-voltage operation, but above-bandgap triggering requires deep-ultraviolet excitation. Here, we investigate a 650-um-thick, 0.01% Fe-doped $\beta$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ impurity PCSS with a 5-mm lateral gap under continuous-wave (CW) 808-nm sub-bandgap excitation at biases up to 10 kV ( 20 kV cm^-1). The device exhibited clear sub-bandgap photoconductive switching. As the optical power density increased from 0.64 to 3.18 W cm^-2, the ON-state current increased progressively while the ON-state resistance decreased, consistent with enhanced defect-assisted photocarrier generation. A higher applied bias further strengthened the switching response through enhanced field-assisted carrier transport. The ON/OFF ratio increases with optical power density but exhibits a nonmonotonic bias dependence, reaching approximately 15-16 near 5-7 kV. At 10 kV, increased OFF-state conduction and non-ideal transient behavior reduce the switching contrast. These results demonstrate near-infrared photoconductive switching but also highlight critical trade-offs in photoconductive thresholds for impurity states.

AI.tldr: 研究了0.01% Fe掺杂、650 μm厚β-Ga2O3杂质光电导开关在808 nm近红外亚带隙连续光激发下的开关特性，验证了亚带隙光电导开关行为，并揭示光功率密度与偏压对导通电流、导通电阻及开关比的非单调影响。
AI.motivation: β-Ga2O3光电导开关适合高压应用，但传统带隙以上触发需要深紫外激发；本文旨在探索利用Fe杂质态的亚带隙近红外激发实现光电导开关，并评估其在高偏压下的可行性及光导阈值折衷。
AI.method: 制备650 μm厚、0.01% Fe掺杂的β-Ga2O3杂质光电导开关，横向间隙5 mm；在808 nm连续波亚带隙激发下施加最高10 kV偏压（约20 kV cm^-1），改变光功率密度（0.64–3.18 W cm^-2）和偏压，测量开关导通电流、导通电阻、开关比及瞬态响应。
AI.result: 器件表现出明显的亚带隙光电导开关效应；光功率密度升高使ON态电流增大、ON态电阻降低，符合缺陷辅助光生载流子增强机制；更高偏压通过场辅助载流子输运增强开关响应。ON/OFF比随光功率密度增加，但对偏压呈非单调依赖，在约5–7 kV达到约15–16；10 kV时OFF态导电增加和非理想瞬态行为降低开关对比度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了β-Ga2O3杂质光电导开关可由近红外亚带隙光触发，但同时指出杂质态光导阈值存在关键折衷：高偏压虽增强导通，却会增加关态漏导并恶化瞬态开关对比度。

title: Unifying dynamical electron-electron and electron-phonon interactions from first principles
summary: Electron-phonon interactions in materials with free carriers are dynamically screened by low-energy electronic excitations, yet first-principles calculations almost always treat this screening in the adiabatic approximation. A fully dynamical treatment of metals and doped semiconductors within time-dependent density functional perturbation theory (TDDFPT) is expensive and numerically delicate. Here, we introduce DFPT+A downfolding ("A" for active space), which starts from the static density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) response of a computationally convenient base system and adds the dynamical screening of a low-energy active space, described by Wannier functions. The required statically screened electron-electron interaction is computed using DFPT directly in the basis of Wannier-function pairs and truncated in a computationally efficient and systematically improvable way. The method handles entangled bands and accurately reproduces TDDFPT at a fraction of its cost. We use it to compute the total dynamical electron-electron interaction, including direct Coulomb and phonon-mediated interactions with dynamically screened electron-electron and electron-phonon couplings, all on equal footing. In hole-doped monolayer hBN, the hybridization of the carrier plasmon with the longitudinal optical phonon makes the low-energy retarded interaction nonmonotonic in the carrier density, an effect missed by the adiabatic approximation. In metallic monolayer TaS2, nonadiabatic effects are weak and occur only due to the intraband electron-hole continuum and the nesting of nearly parallel Fermi velocities. We also validate the widely used screened-screened approximation for the phonon spectral function. This work opens the way to first-principles studies of spectral functions, transport, and superconductivity with dynamically screened interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出DFPT+A降维方法，以低成本准确处理金属和掺杂半导体中动态屏蔽的电子-声子相互作用，并揭示hBN中载流子等离激元与LO声子杂化导致的非单调推迟相互作用。
AI.motivation: 自由载流子对电子-声子相互作用的动态屏蔽在第一性原理中通常采用绝热近似；完全动态的TDDFPT计算昂贵且数值脆弱，因此需要高效且可系统改进的动态屏蔽方法。
AI.method: DFPT+A从计算便利的基础体系的静态DFPT响应出发，加入由Wannier函数描述的低能活性空间的动态屏蔽；在Wannier函数对基组中用DFPT计算静态屏蔽电子-电子相互作用，并进行高效且可系统改进的截断；方法可处理纠缠能带，并以远低于TDDFPT的成本复现其精度，同时在同一框架下计算直接库仑与声子介导相互作用及动态屏蔽的电子-电子和电子-声子耦合。
AI.result: 在空穴掺杂单层hBN中，载流子等离激元与纵向光学声子杂化使低能推迟相互作用随载流子密度呈非单调变化，而绝热近似遗漏该效应；在金属单层TaS2中，非绝热效应较弱，仅源于带内电子-空穴连续谱和近平行费米速度的嵌套；并验证了常用的phonon spectral function的screened-screened近似。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为使用动态屏蔽相互作用开展谱函数、输运和超导性的第一性原理研究开辟了道路。

title: ORCHID: Connecting Finite-Temperature Thermodynamic Evidence to Computational Materials Discovery
summary: Finite-temperature phase stability is essential to materials discovery, but the evidence needed to describe it remains scattered across decades of literature. ORCHID organizes this evidence around the thermodynamic states that the observations describe, using tiered agentic extraction guided by thermodynamic rules, expert supervision and explicit validation. The collection contains 73,542 values from 1,321 papers, represented with their thermodynamic states, phase identities, provenance, evidence classes and uncertainty, together with assessed phase assemblages and calculated references. A qualified subset is released in ESPEI-compatible form for CALPHAD assessment, and machine-readable access supports both human and AI-assisted reuse. Blind expert evaluation of 48 diagram fields gives 93.8% agreement, increasing to 97.9% after accounting for notation conventions. On a common formation-enthalpy benchmark, eight MLIPs show residual spreads close to their DFT reference, motivating evaluation of finite-temperature phase stability through PhaseForge. One-shot MLIP-PhaseForge descriptions of Cu-Zr recover 0.35-0.56 of observed phase occurrences at assessed field points. ORCHID-assisted refinement through PhaseForge+ recovers 9 of 13 invariant temperatures within 2 sigma and reduces held-out activity error from 5.1 to 1.7 kJ/mol. By supplying interpreted literature evidence directly to gradient-based refinement through PhaseForge+, ORCHID connects evidence recovery to programmatic CALPHAD assessment. With the initial description and fitting datasets prepared, the final Cu-Zr refinement completes in approximately 27 minutes, providing a foundation for continuously updated thermodynamic models and their use in materials discovery.

AI.tldr: ORCHID 将数十年来分散的有限温度相稳定性文献证据组织为带热力学状态、相身份、来源、证据等级和不确定度的结构化数据集，并通过 PhaseForge+ 把文献证据提取与程序化 CALPHAD 评估和精修连接起来。
AI.motivation: 有限温度相稳定性对材料发现至关重要，但相关证据长期分散在文献中，难以直接用于热力学建模和 CALPHAD 评估。
AI.method: ORCHID 以热力学状态为核心组织证据，采用受热力学规则、专家监督和显式验证引导的分层智能体提取，收录 73,542 个数值、来自 1,321 篇论文，并记录热力学状态、相身份、来源、证据类别、不确定度、评估相组合和计算参考；合格子集以 ESPEI 兼容格式发布，支持 CALPHAD 评估和机器可读复用。
AI.result: 对 48 个相图区域的盲评专家评估达到 93.8% 一致率，考虑记号惯例后为 97.9%；在共同形成焓基准上，八种 MLIP 的残差分布接近其 DFT 参考；单次 MLIP-PhaseForge 对 Cu-Zr 在评估场点恢复 0.35–0.56 的观测相出现率；经 ORCHID 辅助的 PhaseForge+ 精修在 2σ 内恢复 13 个不变温度中的 9 个，并将留出活度误差从 5.1 降至 1.7 kJ/mol。
AI.conclusion: ORCHID 通过向 PhaseForge+ 的梯度精修直接提供经解释的文献证据，将证据回收与程序化 CALPHAD 评估相连；Cu-Zr 最终精修约 27 分钟完成，为持续更新的热力学模型及其材料发现应用奠定基础。

title: Strong-Field-Driven Non-Linear Vibronic Coupling in an Asymmetric Donor-Acceptor Oligomer
summary: Understanding how nuclear motion couples to intramolecular charge transfer beyond the perturbative regime of light--matter interaction remains an open problem. We tackle this problem by investigating the electron-nuclear response of an acceptor-donor-acceptor oligomer with structural asymmetry due to the partial fluorination of an acceptor unit. Adopting real-time time-dependent density functional theory combined with Ehrenfest dynamics, we excite the systems with a resonant pulse of varying intensity, spanning the weak-, intermediate-, and strong-coupling regimes. When nuclei are clamped, field-driven charge preferentially flows from the donor to the fluorinated acceptor, with selectivity reduced upon increasing intensity. With moving ions, the early-time spatial response remains qualitatively unchanged, despite a distinct, spatially asymmetric charge redistribution. In the strong-field regime, nuclear motion preserves the preference for field-driven charge accumulation on the fluorinated acceptor, although the process takes approximately twice the time as in the fixed-nuclei scenario. Mode-resolved kinetic-energy analysis reveals that, with increasing field strength, the laser-induced nuclear response shifts from selected bond stretchings to collective low-frequency modes. These results provide a benchmark for assessing the interplay between vibronic dynamics and strong-field coupling in donor/acceptor oligomers.

AI.tldr: 该文用实时含时密度泛函理论结合Ehrenfest动力学，研究部分氟化受体导致结构不对称的受体-给体-受体低聚物在弱、中、强光场下核运动与分子内电荷转移的耦合。
AI.motivation: 超越光-物质相互作用的微扰区，理解核运动如何影响分子内电荷转移仍是开放问题，尤其缺乏对强场下供体/受体低聚物中电子-核响应的系统认识。
AI.method: 构建受体-给体-受体低聚物，利用受体单元部分氟化引入结构不对称；采用实时含时密度泛函理论（RT-TDDFT）与Ehrenfest动力学，以不同强度的共振脉冲激发体系，覆盖弱、中、强耦合区，并比较固定核与可动核情形，进行模式分辨的动能分析。
AI.result: 固定核时，场驱动电荷优先从给体流向氟化受体，随强度增加选择性降低；可动核时，早期空间响应定性不变，但出现明显的空间不对称电荷再分布。强场下核运动仍保持电荷优先积累于氟化受体，但所需时间约为固定核情形的两倍。模式分辨动能分析表明，随场强增加，激光诱导核响应从选择性键伸缩转向集体低频模式。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了振动电子动力学与强场耦合在供体/受体低聚物中的相互作用，并为评估此类体系中核运动对分子内电荷转移的影响提供了基准。

title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. I. Clean surface properties
summary: Ab initio calculations were used to elucidate the properties of the polar surfaces of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors, i.e., metal- and nonmetal-terminated. The systems considered were clean wurtzite gallium nitride (i.e. (0001) and (000-1) GaN surfaces), zinc blende gallium phosphide (i.e. (111) and (-1-1-1) GaP), gallium arsenide (i.e. (111) and (-1-1-1) GaAs), and (111) and (-1-1-1) GaSb surfaces. The calculated data include the crystallographic structure and the electronic states of the termination atoms on both sides, i.e. their positions, energies, and occupations. All nonmetal-terminated surfaces exhibit no reconstruction, and their broken-bond states are located in the vicinity of the valence band maxima (VBM), pinning the Fermi level. The Ga-terminated surface exhibited (4 x 4) reconstruction related to the division of termination atoms into sp3 and sp2 hybridized in proportions of 6 to 10, based on charge redistribution according to the electron counting rule (ECR). Thus, the broken-bond state is separated into two sets, occupied and empty, with the Fermi level located between them in the vicinity of the conduction band minimum (CBM).

AI.tldr: 利用从头算计算研究III-V族四面体半导体极性表面的金属/非金属终止结构及其电子态，发现非金属终止表面无重构且费米能级钉扎在价带顶附近，而Ga终止表面发生(4×4)重构并使费米能级位于占据与空 broken-bond 态之间、靠近导带底。
AI.motivation: 阐明III-V族四面体半导体金属终止与非金属终止极性表面的结构、终止原子电子态及费米能级钉扎行为，理解极性表面的稳定性与电子性质。
AI.method: 采用从头算（ab initio）计算，研究对象包括纤锌矿GaN的(0001)和(000-1)表面，以及闪锌矿GaP、GaAs、GaSb的(111)和(-1-1-1)表面；计算内容包括晶体结构以及两侧终止原子的位置、能量和占据等电子态。
AI.result: 所有非金属终止表面均无重构，其断键态位于价带顶（VBM）附近并钉扎费米能级。Ga终止表面出现(4×4)重构，与终止原子按电子计数规则（ECR）发生电荷重分布后分为sp3和sp2杂化、比例约为6:10有关；断键态因此分裂为占据态和空态两组，费米能级位于二者之间并靠近导带底（CBM）。
AI.conclusion: III-V族半导体极性表面的终止原子类型决定其重构与费米能级钉扎：非金属终止表面无重构且断键态近VBM，Ga终止表面通过(4×4)重构和sp3/sp2再杂化实现电荷重新分布，使费米能级移至近CBM的占据/空断键态之间。

title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. II. Adsorption of nonmetal atoms (N, P, As, and Sb) on Ga-terminated surfaces
summary: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate the adsorption processes on Ga-terminated surfaces of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. The considered adsorbates are nonmetal species, i.e., nitrogen, phosphorus, arsenic, and antimony on wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e., GaN(0001) surfaces, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e., GaP(111), gallium arsenide, GaAs(111), and gallium antimonide, GaSb (111) surfaces. The cases investigated include single adsorbed nonmetal atoms and full coverage, i.e. theta=1 of these surfaces. The calculated results include the stable sites and the energies of the single adsorbed atoms: located at H3 sites at low coverage and in on-top positions at high coverage for GaP, GaAs and GaSb. At high nitrogen coverage, the N2 admolecules are formed, weakly attached to the surface. The calculated electronic properties of the single-adatom systems include the band diagrams of the slabs in real and momentum space, the energies of the quantum states. In addition, the overlaps of the quantum states of the nonmetal adatoms and the nearest topmost surface Ga atoms are given. The full coverage data include the atomic configurations and the bond energies of the adsorbed layers. The electronic properties include the above-mentioned data for single adatoms, together with additional properties related to interactions between adsorbed atoms. The evaporation stability analysis confirms that the adatoms stabilize the topmost Ga atoms against detachment because of the high energy barrier of DE > 3 eV which is further increased to DE > 4 eV by coverage located at H3 sites. Thus, growth simulations should employ unreconstructed Ga-terminated surfaces covered by nonmetal atoms located at on-top positions.

AI.tldr: 采用从头算方法系统模拟了非金属原子在GaN、GaP、GaAs和GaSb的Ga终止表面上的吸附，并给出低覆盖与全覆盖下的稳定位点、能量和电子结构。
AI.motivation: 为理解Ga终止III-V族半导体表面在非金属吸附下的稳定性与重构行为，并为外延生长模拟选择合理表面模型提供依据。
AI.method: 使用从头算计算研究N、P、As、Sb在GaN(0001)、GaP(111)、GaAs(111)和GaSb(111)表面的单原子吸附及θ=1全覆盖吸附，分析稳定吸附位、吸附能、键能、实空间与动量空间能带、量子态能量及吸附原子与最近邻表层Ga原子的态重叠。
AI.result: 低覆盖时吸附原子位于H3位；GaP、GaAs和GaSb在高覆盖时转为on-top位。高氮覆盖下形成弱吸附的N2分子。吸附原子可稳定表层Ga原子，抑制其脱附，脱附能垒DE>3 eV；H3位全覆盖时能垒进一步提高至DE>4 eV。
AI.conclusion: 非金属吸附原子显著增强Ga终止表面的热稳定性；生长模拟应采用未重构、并由位于on-top位的非金属原子覆盖的Ga终止表面模型。

title: Mirror-symmetry engineering of altermagnetism based on monolayer hexagonal lattices
summary: Altermagnetism (AM) is a novel collinear antiferromagnetic phase characterized by spin-polarized bands and zero net magnetization. However, realizing AM in monolayer hexagonal lattices is strongly constrained by lattice symmetry. Here, we propose a mirror-symmetry-based design principle and implementation scheme for realizing AM based on monolayer hexagonal lattices and validate it using holey graphyne (HGY) as a representative system. By examining hydrogenated nonmetal units X$-$H (X = B, C, N, P, and S) introduced along the mirror-symmetry axis and extending the analysis to N$-$F, we identify the configurations that form two antiparallel spin sublattices related by mirror reflection. The N$-$H structure forms a stable altermagnetic ground state, with a momentum-dependent spin splitting up to 148.2 meV. The magnetism originates from $\pi-\pi$ superexchange interactions, and H/F functionalization stabilizes intrinsic AM by regulating the local charge distribution. Our work offers insights into the design of light-element altermagnetic materials.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于镜面对称的单层六方晶格交错磁设计原则，并以多孔石墨炔（HGY）验证，发现N-H功能化可形成稳定本征交错磁基态，自旋劈裂达148.2 meV。
AI.motivation: 交错磁（AM）具有自旋极化能带和零净磁矩，但在单层六方晶格中受晶格对称性强烈限制，亟需可实现AM的对称性设计策略。
AI.method: 提出基于镜面对称的设计原则，以HGY为代表性单层六方体系，沿镜面对称轴引入非金属氢化单元X-H（X=B、C、N、P、S）并扩展至N-F，筛选可由镜面反射联系的两个反平行自旋子晶格构型。
AI.result: N-H结构形成稳定的交错磁基态，表现出动量依赖的自旋劈裂，最大达148.2 meV；磁性来源于π-π超交换相互作用，H/F功能化通过调控局域电荷分布稳定本征AM。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了在单层六方晶格中实现交错磁的镜面对称设计思路，并为轻元素交错磁材料的设计提供指导。

title: Microscopic structure at the morphotropic phase boundary in lead-barium meta-niobat
summary: Lead-barium niobate Pb$_{1-x}$Ba$_x$Nb$_2$O$_6$ is a tetragonal tungsten-bronze ferroelectric that exhibits enhanced functional properties near a morphotropic phase boundary separating orthorhombic and tetragonal phases. Using first-principles electronic-structure calculations combined with ab initio molecular dynamics, we investigate how Ba substitution modifies cation-site occupancy, local distortions, and polarization behavior across the solid solution. By explicitly accounting for vacancy ordering and the inequivalent $A$-site cages intrinsic to the tungsten-bronze framework, we identify the structural origin of the orthorhombic-to-tetragonal transition. Increasing Ba content progressively weakens the cooperative in-plane off-centering of Pb ions in the pentagonal channels and promotes out-of-plane displacements of Nb and $A$-site cations, leading to a rotation of the spontaneous polarization from [110] to [001]. The transition occurs near $x \approx 0.6$, in quantitative agreement with experimental phase diagrams. These results provide a microscopic interpretation of the morphotropic phase boundary in Pb$_{1-x}$Ba$_x$Nb$_2$O$_6$ and establish a clear structure-polarization relationship for tungsten-bronze ferroelectrics.

AI.tldr: 采用第一性原理电子结构计算与从头算分子动力学，揭示 Pb$_{1-x}$Ba$_x$Nb$_2$O$_6$ 中 Ba 取代导致极化从 [110] 转向 [001] 的微观机制，并在 $x\approx0.6$ 处再现正交-四方相变。
AI.motivation: 该钨青铜铁电体在正交相与四方相之间的准同型相界附近具有增强功能性质，但其阳离子占位、局域畸变和极化旋转的结构起源尚不清晰。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理电子结构计算和从头算分子动力学，显式考虑空位有序及钨青铜骨架中非等价 $A$ 位笼，研究 Ba 取代对阳离子占位、局域畸变和极化行为的影响。
AI.result: 随 Ba 含量增加，五边形通道中 Pb 的面内偏心协同作用减弱，Nb 与 $A$ 位阳离子的面外位移增强，使自发极化由 [110] 转向 [001]；相变发生在 $x\approx0.6$，与实验相图定量一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了 Pb$_{1-x}$Ba$_x$Nb$_2$O$_6$ 准同型相界的微观解释，并建立了钨青铜铁电体中清晰的结构-极化关系。

title: Spontaneous Circular Dichroism and Memory Effect from Surface Defects in Altermagnetic MnTe
summary: Altermagnetism has emerged as a new class of magnetism with vanishing magnetization and macroscopic time reversal symmetry breaking. Hexagonal MnTe is a g-wave altermagnet with a 307 K N\'eel temperature, large spin splitting, and an anomalous Hall effect. However, the relationship between altermagnetism and the anomalous Hall effect in MnTe remains debated. Here, using optical magnetic circular dichroism, we observe hysteresis and a memory effect in a MnTe bulk crystal below 250 K. No hysteresis is seen after polishing the bulk crystal and in thin films. We conclude that the hysteresis in magnetic circular dichroism in the bulk crystal is from surface defects. The similar temperature dependence and a sign change between circular dichroism and the anomalous Hall effect indicate that the origin of the anomalous Hall effect in transport is likely not intrinsic.

AI.tldr: 该文通过光学磁圆二色性研究六角MnTe中的滞回与记忆效应，并将其与反常霍尔效应联系，指出体单晶中的滞回源于表面缺陷，输运中的反常霍尔效应很可能不是内禀的。
AI.motivation: MnTe是g波交变磁体，具有307 K奈尔温度、大自旋劈裂和反常霍尔效应，但交变磁性与其反常霍尔效应之间的关系仍存在争议；需要厘清该霍尔效应的内禀/外禀起源。
AI.method: 对MnTe体单晶、抛光后的体单晶以及薄膜进行光学磁圆二色性测量，观察滞回和记忆效应，并与输运中的反常霍尔效应进行温度依赖性和符号变化比较。
AI.result: 在250 K以下，MnTe体单晶的磁圆二色性出现滞回和记忆效应；抛光后的体单晶和薄膜中未观察到滞回。磁圆二色性与反常霍尔效应具有相似的温度依赖性并发生符号变化。
AI.conclusion: 体单晶磁圆二色性中的滞回来自表面缺陷；磁圆二色性与反常霍尔效应的相似温度依赖性和符号变化表明，输运中的反常霍尔效应很可能并非内禀起源。
