title: Full-Potential Korringa Kohn Rostoker Study of Structural and Mechanical Properties in SiGeSn Alloys
summary: Accurate first-principles descriptions of open, covalently bonded crystal structures remain challenging within conventional Korringa--Kohn--Rostoker (KKR) approaches owing to the spherical approximations commonly employed for the effective crystal potential. Here, we systematically assess the recently developed full-potential KKR (KKR-FP) implementation in the open-source MuST package and demonstrate its applicability to diamond-structured group-IV semiconductors and SiGeSn alloys. Benchmark calculations for diamond-structured Si reveal substantial limitations of the conventional muffin-tin and atomic sphere approximations, whereas KKR-FP accurately reproduces the experimental equilibrium lattice parameter and bulk modulus, yielding 5.433 and 94.9 GPa. The full-potential treatment also recovers the semiconducting character of Si. Further calculations for elemental Ge and Sn establish the applicability of the approach across group-IV materials. Extending this framework to SiGeSn alloys, we investigate their composition-dependent equilibrium lattice parameters, bulk moduli, and mixing enthalpies. The calculated lattice parameters exhibit positive deviations from Vegard's law, while the bulk modulus decreases substantially with changes in alloy composition. Moreover, positive mixing enthalpies of 180.92 and 346.32 meV/atom are obtained for Si0.5Ge0.375Sn0.125 and Si0.375Ge0.25Sn0.375, respectively, indicating an energetic penalty for homogeneous alloy formation relative to the selected elemental reference states. These findings highlight the importance of nonspherical potential contributions in accurately describing open-structured semiconductors and establish KKR-FP within MuST as a promising framework for investigating the structural properties and mixing energetics of compositionally complex group-IV alloys

AI.tldr: 该文系统评估了MuST中的全势KKR方法，并证明其能准确描述钻石结构IV族半导体及SiGeSn合金的结构与混合热力学性质。
AI.motivation: 传统KKR对有效晶体势采用球形近似，难以准确处理开放、共价键合的晶体结构，因此需要验证全势KKR在IV族半导体和合金中的适用性。
AI.method: 作者在开源MuST包中采用全势KKR（KKR-FP），以钻石结构Si为基准，与传统muffin-tin和原子球近似比较，并扩展到Ge、Sn及SiGeSn合金，计算平衡晶格常数、体模量和混合焓。
AI.result: KKR-FP准确重现Si的实验平衡晶格常数5.433 Å和体模量94.9 GPa，并恢复其半导体特性；Ge和Sn计算表明方法适用于IV族材料。SiGeSn合金晶格常数相对Vegard定律呈正偏差，体模量随组分显著降低；Si0.5Ge0.375Sn0.125和Si0.375Ge0.25Sn0.375的混合焓分别为180.92和346.32 meV/atom，表明均匀合金形成存在能量惩罚。
AI.conclusion: 非球形势贡献对开放结构半导体的准确描述至关重要，MuST中的KKR-FP是研究组分复杂IV族合金结构性质和混合热力学的有前景框架。

title: Magnetic control of reflectionless states and an intrinsic-mode exceptional point in a magnon-phonon coupling system
summary: Reflectionless states (RLs) and exceptional points (EPs) are hallmark singular responses of non-Hermitian systems, with potential applications in sensing, wave control, and energy manipulation. Yet, realizing and independently tuning these states in a compact integrated platform remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate two-dimensional magnetic control of RLs and EPs in an on-chip magnon-phonon system based on a FeGaB-32 degree-YX-LiNbO3 heterostructure. The magnetic-field magnitude tunes the magnon-phonon detuning, driving a low-loss reflection zero across the real-frequency axis and producing two field-tunable RLs with near-vanishing reflection. A closed contour of the experimentally measured complex S11 around the reflection-zero singularity accumulates a -2pi phase winding. Independently, rotating the magnetic field tunes the magnon-phonon coupling strength, driving the intrinsic magnon-phonon eigenmode spectrum across an exceptional point, identified by the exchange between real-part and imaginary-part eigenvalue splitting. A unified one-port input-output model connects the measured complex S11 response to the field-driven dynamics of the reflection zeros and the angle-tuned intrinsic magnon-phonon eigenmodes. These results establish a magnetically programmable non-Hermitian magnon-phonon platform for integrated wave control and compact vector magnetic sensing.

AI.tldr: 在FeGaB/32°YX-LiNbO3片上磁声系统中，利用磁场幅度与方向二维独立调控反射零点（RL）与例外点（EP），并建立单端口输入-输出模型统一描述复S11响应。
AI.motivation: RL与EP是非厄米系统的重要奇异响应，在传感、波调控和能量操控方面有潜力，但在紧凑集成平台上同时实现并独立调控仍具挑战。
AI.method: 构建基于FeGaB-32°YX-LiNbO3异质结构的片上磁声系统；通过改变磁场幅度调节磁声失谐以驱动实频轴上的低损耗反射零点，通过旋转磁场调节磁声耦合强度以驱动本征模态跨越EP；并用统一的一端口输入-输出模型将复S11测量与RL动力学及角度调谐本征模联系起来。
AI.result: 磁场幅度可产生两个近零反射的可调RL，实验测得复S11围绕反射零点奇点形成闭合轨迹并累积-2π相位绕数；磁场方向可调耦合强度，使磁声本征模谱跨越EP，并通过实部与虚部本征值劈裂的交换识别EP。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了磁可编程的非厄米磁声平台，可独立调控RL与EP，为集成波控制和紧凑型矢量磁传感提供了方案。

title: Generative Design and Graph Neural Network Screening of Novel Bimetallic Alloy Catalysts for the Hydrogen Evolution Reaction
summary: Identifying earth-abundant catalysts for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) is a central challenge in scalable green hydrogen production. We present a computational pipeline that couples diffusion-based generative modelling, machine-learning force-field relaxation, and graph neural network (GNN) property prediction to discover bimetallic HER catalysts beyond the structures and stoichiometries covered by existing adsorption databases. A generative model (MatterGen) is fine-tuned on bulk alloy structures labelled with their minimum hydrogen adsorption energy and steered towards adsorption energies near zero. From the generated pool we retain the stable structures that are novel bimetallic alloys: binary compositions built from the training-set metals but at stoichiometries or structures absent from that database. Each candidate's low-index facets are ranked by a machine-learning-force-field (MatterSim) surface-energy screen, and only the most stable terminations are converted into explicit slab models with hydrogen adsorbed at all high-symmetry surface sites and relaxed with the same force field. Two GNN surrogates (MEGNet and ALIGNN), trained on a high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) dataset, then screen the resulting slab candidates. Because the two models encode the local environment through different inductive biases, we retain only the alloys on which both agree, reducing the influence of any single model. This consensus screening, combined with a MatterSim energy-difference triangulation, resulted in a shortlist of near-thermoneutral bimetallic candidates. Eight are validated with plane-wave DFT, and four of them, Pd5Au, Pt5Rh, Cu5Pt3, and Pd13Ru3, bind hydrogen within the thermoneutral window. All eight alloys are dynamically stable by phonon calculations. These four alloys are highlighted as DFT-validated bimetallic HER candidates for experimental follow-up.

AI.tldr: 该文提出将扩散生成模型、机器学习力场弛豫与图神经网络性质预测耦合的计算流程，用于发现现有吸附数据库未覆盖的双金属析氢反应催化剂，并获得4个DFT验证的近热中性候选材料。
AI.motivation: 规模化绿氢生产需要地球丰度高、性能优异的HER催化剂；现有吸附数据库在双金属合金的结构与化学计量比覆盖上有限，需超越数据库进行新材料发现。
AI.method: 以标注最小氢吸附能并朝向近零吸附能优化的MatterGen生成块体合金结构；筛选稳定且新颖的双金属合金，用MatterSim对低指数晶面进行表面能筛选并构建最稳定终止面的显式slab，在高对称位点吸附氢并弛豫；再用基于高通量DFT数据训练的MEGNet与ALIGNN两个GNN代理模型进行共识筛选，并结合MatterSim能量差三角验证得到近热中性短名单。
AI.result: 短名单中8种双金属合金经平面波DFT验证，其中Pd5Au、Pt5Rh、Cu5Pt3和Pd13Ru3的氢吸附能位于热中性窗口内；8种合金均通过声子计算证明动力学稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该生成—弛豫—预测—共识筛选流程可有效发现数据库外双金属HER候选材料；4个DFT验证的近热中性合金被推荐用于后续实验研究。

title: Shock Loading Accesses Reaction Pathways beyond Accelerated Thermolysis
summary: Thermolysis and shock loading can produce similar major stable products in energetic materials, despite different chemical evolution and reaction pathways. Here, we develop EMFF-MACE, a reactive machine-learning potential for C/H/N/O energetic materials, enabling thermolysis simulations of 20 materials and shock simulations of 10 on a common potential energy surface. Comparisons at matched normalized reaction progress reveal divergent chemical states and local structural environments. Mean reaction-state similarity decreases from 94.0% at 20% progress to 25.9% at trajectory endpoints, while 47.1-92.6% of shock local environments lie outside corresponding material-specific thermolysis reference domains. Structural and reaction-network analyses reveal enhanced intermolecular reorganization and additional association and rearrangement branches under shock loading, despite partially shared early decomposition chemistry. These findings show that loading history influences the structural states and subsequent reaction pathways accessed during decomposition, rather than merely the rate of thermolysis.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用于C/H/N/O含能材料的反应性机器学习势EMFF-MACE，并在统一势能面上系统比较热解与冲击加载下的分解化学状态与反应路径。
AI.motivation: 热解与冲击加载可生成相似的主要稳定产物，但其化学演化和反应路径不同；需要在大规模模拟中辨析加载历史对分解机制的影响。
AI.method: 构建EMFF-MACE反应性机器学习势，对20种含能材料进行热解模拟、对10种进行冲击模拟，并在匹配归一化反应进度下比较化学状态、局部结构环境和反应网络。
AI.result: 匹配反应进度下二者化学状态显著分化，平均反应态相似度由20%进度时的94.0%降至轨迹终点时的25.9%；47.1–92.6%的冲击局部环境落在对应材料热解参考域之外。结构及反应网络分析显示冲击下分子间重组增强，并出现额外的缔合与重排分支，尽管早期分解化学部分共享。
AI.conclusion: 加载历史不仅改变热解速率，还影响分解过程中可达的结构状态及后续反应路径。

title: Tensor cluster expansion as an efficient surrogate for multi-ACE
summary: In this work, we generalize an on-lattice tensor cluster expansion (TCE) framework to an arbitrary correlation order. We show that these generalized tensor cluster expansion features span a subspace of MACE features, suggesting that TCE features can sufficiently pre-screen MACE features for chemical diversity in alloyed transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers. We show that, using maximum-entropy subset sampling, we can empirically recover chemical diversity from MACE features using a cheaper TCE representation. We then fine-tune a multi-ACE (MACE) potential with both subsets, and use this potential to predict temperature-dependent vibrational properties in alloyed TMD monolayers with varying chemical ordering. In our approach, TCE features can be used as cheap surrogate features for pre-screening chemically rich configurations using MACE features, allowing for the more efficient finetuning of atomic cluster expansion (ACE) potentials, thus achieving a tractable prediction of finite-temperature alloy thermodynamics on modest hardware.

AI.tldr: 将格点张量团簇展开（TCE）推广到任意关联阶，并证明其特征构成MACE特征子空间，可作为廉价代理预筛合金化TMD单层中的化学多样构型，从而高效微调MACE势并预测有限温度振动与合金热力学。
AI.motivation: 合金化过渡金属硫族化物（TMD）单层的化学有序与有限温度热力学预测需要覆盖化学多样性的构型，但直接使用MACE特征或微调ACE势成本较高，需要廉价预筛方法。
AI.method: 将on-lattice TCE推广至任意相关阶；分析其与MACE特征的子空间关系；采用最大熵子集采样从MACE特征中经验恢复化学多样性；用TCE与MACE子集微调多ACE（MACE）势，并预测不同化学有序合金化TMD单层的温度依赖振动性质。
AI.result: 广义TCE特征张成MACE特征的子空间；在最大熵子集采样下，较便宜的TCE表示可经验恢复MACE特征中的化学多样性；基于两类子集微调的MACE势可预测不同化学有序合金化TMD单层的温度依赖振动性质。
AI.conclusion: TCE特征可作为廉价代理特征预筛化学丰富构型，提升ACE/MACE势微调效率，使有限温度合金热力学预测可在普通硬件上可行。

title: Generation and spectroscopic characterization of continuous-wave 148.4-nm light in strontium tetraborate
summary: Continuous-wave (CW) radiation at 148.4~nm is required to drive the $^{229}$Th isomeric transition of a solid-state nuclear clock, and frequency doubling of 296.8-nm light is its most direct source. We generate CW 148.4-nm light by random quasi-phase matching in strontium tetraborate and characterize it with a compact prism spectrometer built for the purpose. The spectrometer separates the harmonic from the pump on a CaF$_2$ prism, reads the wavelength from the rotation angle of a solar-blind photomultiplier, resolves the two lines with $\delta\lambda \approx 0.6~nm$, and yields an absolute power calibration. At room temperature the source delivers $1.9~nW$ at 148.4~nm, rising to 5.7 nW at the optimum crystal temperature. The conversion efficiency is also strongly structured in temperature: between 30 degree and 50 degree it shows several pronounced maxima, with neighbouring extrema only a few degrees apart, so that a small temperature excursion moves the output from a maximum to a minimum. These results provide practical guidance for optimizing and stabilizing 148.4-nm sources for solid-state $^{229}$Th nuclear clocks.

AI.tldr: 该文利用四硼酸锶中的随机准相位匹配产生连续波148.4 nm光，并用自制紧凑棱镜光谱仪表征，为固态^{229}Th核钟提供光源方案。
AI.motivation: 驱动固态^{229}Th同质异能跃迁需要148.4 nm连续波辐射，而对296.8 nm光倍频是最直接的产生途径。
AI.method: 在四硼酸锶晶体中通过随机准相位匹配产生148.4 nm连续光；用CaF2棱镜分离谐波与泵浦，用日盲光电倍增管根据旋转角读取波长，光谱分辨率约0.6 nm，并实现绝对功率校准。
AI.result: 室温下148.4 nm输出功率为1.9 nW，晶体温度最优时升至5.7 nW；30至50摄氏度间转换效率随温度强烈起伏，出现多个明显极大值，相邻极值仅相差几度，微小温度漂移即可使输出从极大变为极小。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了优化与稳定148.4 nm光源的实用依据，有助于推进固态^{229}Th核钟所需连续波光源的发展。

title: Quantum 3xplorer: AI-Native Engine for Next-Generation Quantum Materials Modeling
summary: Quantum-mechanical approaches, such as density functional theory (DFT), underpin much of modern computational materials science and are the primary source of data for AI-driven discovery. Yet the established electronic-structure codes today represent decades-old software architectures, making new physical models slow and costly to implement, validate, and deploy on emerging hardware. We present Quantum 3xplorer (Q3, pronounced "Quantum Explorer"), an AI-native quantum simulation engine written from scratch by AI coding agents under the direction and supervision of domain scientists. As a first and demanding validation case, we implement plane-wave pseudopotential DFT end to end: norm-conserving, ultrasoft, and projector-augmented-wave formalisms, spin polarization, DFT+U, and dispersion corrections, together with forces, stresses, structural relaxation, and electronic-structure analysis. Q3 reproduces established reference implementations, runs faster on a single core in representative benchmarks, and scales across GPU-accelerated supercomputers. It was developed in weeks rather than years. Its layered, physics-first architecture separates abstract quantum-mechanical concepts from their numerical representations, making its framework extendable beyond plane waves to other basis sets and levels of theory. Its inputs and outputs follow structured, schema-validated data standards, making every result AI-ready. Q3 is open source under Apache 2.0 and built to be reused, extended, and improved by the research community. Q3 points to a paradigm shift in how computational quantum science is done. Scientists define the physics, formulate the models, and set the criteria for validation; AI agents write, test, and optimize the code. The decades-long path from a new theory to a trusted, high-performance implementation can thus collapse to days, significantly accelerating scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: Q3 是一个由 AI 编码代理在领域科学家监督下从零开发的 AI 原生量子模拟引擎，首个严格验证案例是端到端平面波赝势 DFT。
AI.motivation: DFT 等量子力学方法支撑现代计算材料科学与 AI 驱动发现，但现有电子结构代码多沿用数十年前的软件架构，导致新物理模型实现、验证和部署到新兴硬件上缓慢且昂贵。
AI.method: Q3 采用分层、物理优先架构，将抽象量子力学概念与数值表示分离；实现平面波赝势 DFT 全流程，包括模守恒、超软和 PAW 形式、自旋极化、DFT+U、色散校正，以及力、应力、结构弛豫和电子结构分析；输入输出遵循结构化、模式校验的数据标准。
AI.result: Q3 复现成熟参考实现，在代表性基准中单核运行更快，并可扩展到 GPU 加速超级计算机；开发周期为数周而非数年；采用 Apache 2.0 开源，框架可扩展到其他基组和理论层级，结果具备 AI-ready 特性。
AI.conclusion: Q3 指向计算量子科学范式转变：科学家定义物理、模型和验证标准，AI 代理编写、测试并优化代码，从而将新理论到可信高性能实现的长周期压缩到数天，加速科学发现。

title: Multiband-Induced Complex Magnetotransport in the Kagome Metal LuNb$_6$Sn$_6$
summary: We report the electrical transport properties of the kagome metal LuNb$_6$Sn$_6$, which undergoes a charge density wave (CDW) transition at $T_\mathrm{CDW}\approx80$ K. Similar to the kagome metals $A$V$_3$Sb$_5$ ($A$ = K, Rb, Cs), LuNb$_6$Sn$_6$ develops complex magnetotransport behavior near and below the CDW transition. In particular, the longitudinal magnetoconductivity exhibits an approximately linear field dependence below about 1 T, whereas the field dependence of Hall conductivity displays pronounced nonlinearity and a field-induced sign reversal. Although an anomalous Hall-like contribution can be extracted by subtracting a local background from the Hall conductivity, mobility-spectrum analysis shows that the overall magnetotransport can be largely accounted for by multiband conduction involving high-mobility electronlike and holelike carriers. Nevertheless, sizable deviations from the multiband model emerge near $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$, pointing to additional CDW-related scattering processes. These results demonstrate that high-mobility multiband transport, together with CDW-induced modifications of carrier scattering, play important roles in the complex magnetotransport of LuNb$_6$Sn$_6$.

AI.tldr: 研究了CDW转变温度约80 K的kagome金属LuNb6Sn6的磁输运性质，发现其复杂磁输运主要由高迁移率多带导电及CDW相关散射修正共同决定。
AI.motivation: LuNb6Sn6与AV3Sb5家族类似，在CDW转变附近表现出复杂磁输运；理解其电输运机制有助于揭示kagome金属中CDW与多带载流子输运之间的关系。
AI.method: 通过纵向磁电导和霍尔电导测量分析磁输运行为，并结合迁移率谱分析和多带输运模型拟合，分离可能存在的异常霍尔贡献并检验多带模型适用性。
AI.result: 低于约1 T时纵向磁电导近似线性；霍尔电导随磁场呈显著非线性并发生场致符号反转。扣除局域背景后可提取类异常霍尔贡献，但迁移率谱表明整体磁输运主要可由高迁移率电子型和空穴型载流子的多带导电解释；在T_CDW附近出现明显偏离多带模型的成分。
AI.conclusion: LuNb6Sn6的复杂磁输运由高迁移率多带输运与CDW引起的载流子散射修正共同主导，T_CDW附近的偏离表明存在额外的CDW相关散射过程。

title: A variational phase-field theory of cohesive fracture at finite deformation
summary: This paper formulates a kinematically and variationally consistent phase-field theory for cohesive fracture at finite deformation. The theory introduces an independent compliance-damage field, which accommodates both diffuse distributions and singular concentrations. The phase-field is thereby freed from the dual burden of describing crack geometry and material degradation. A rank-one additive split of the deformation gradient makes separation explicit through independent crack-strain and reference-normal fields. All fields are governed by a single principle of minimum potential energy, which consistently couples nonlinear bulk deformation, crack separation, and crack-plane rotation. One-dimensional energy comparisons show that minimization favors Dirac-type concentration of compliance damage and crack strain. Strong displacement discontinuities thus emerge naturally at a finite phase-field length without being prescribed a priori, while the phase-field remains continuous. The concentrated energy recovers the exact bulk--interface structure of a sharp-crack cohesive zone model. General objective hyperelastic bulk potentials and admissible mixed-mode cohesive laws can therefore be prescribed independently, with the nominal traction--separation law unaffected by the bulk law or phase-field length. Diffuse damage can coexist with concentrated cracks, retaining deformation modes for bulk-energy relaxation during nucleation. Two- and three-dimensional examples validate the theory across large stretches, finite rotations, and complex crack paths. Notably, the computed near-tip Cauchy stress closely matches the analytical 1/r crack-tip asymptotic solution of Long et al. (2011) outside the cohesive zone.

AI.tldr: 提出有限变形下黏聚断裂的相场理论：以独立合规损伤场实现弥散损伤与强间断裂纹的统一，并由单一最小势能原理一致耦合。
AI.motivation: 传统相场同时承担裂纹几何描述与材料退化，导致强间断、黏聚律和相场长度尺度耦合不清；本文旨在解耦这些作用并恢复尖锐裂纹黏聚区结构。
AI.method: 引入独立compliance-damage场，允许弥散分布与奇异集中；对变形梯度作rank-one加性分解，显式表示裂纹应变与参考法向；所有场由最小势能原理控制，耦合非线性体变形、裂纹分离与裂纹面转动；一维能量分析表明能量最小化倾向于Dirac型集中。
AI.result: 强位移间断在有限相场长度下自然涌现而相场保持连续；集中能量精确恢复尖锐裂纹黏聚区模型的体-界面结构；一般客观超弹体势与混合模式黏聚律可独立给定，名义牵引-分离律不受体势或相场长度影响；二维/三维算例验证大拉伸、有限转动和复杂裂纹路径，且黏聚区外裂尖Cauchy应力与Long等(2011)的1/r渐近解吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该理论在变分和运动学一致框架下统一了弥散损伤与强间断黏聚断裂，实现体本构与黏聚律的解耦，并具备有限变形复杂裂纹模拟能力。

title: Fano Resonance of a Magnonic Ring Resonator with a Nano-Scatterer Embedded in a Magnonic Conduit
summary: We present micromagnetic simulation of a nanoscale magnonic ring resonator coupled to a magnonic waveguide, with and without a hole embedded in the waveguide (H-NRR and NRR respectively), for realizing transformation into a Fano resonance frequency spectral lineshape from a Lorentzian one. Transmission and reflection spectra of the H-NRR and NRR have been analyzed for different structural parameters (embedded hole diameter and gap between the ring and the waveguide) and material parameters (damping factor of the ring) to achieve maximum spectral transmission magnitude variation. The obtained micromagnetic simulation results are supported by an analytical model that consists of two-tracks of wave propagation, forwards and backwards. Our findings show that H-NRR system demonstrates a monotonic dependence of spectral transmission magnitude variation against the aforementioned design parameters (gap and damping) which should provide better engineering controllability and tolerance when compared with the original NRR system. Overall, our proposed structure and study may help in building unconventional magnonic integrated circuits for sensing, data processing systems and computing.

AI.tldr: 该文通过微磁学模拟研究带/不带波导嵌入孔的纳米磁振子环形谐振器与波导耦合系统，实现洛伦兹谱线向Fano共振谱线的转换。
AI.motivation: 为获得Fano共振谱线并提升磁振子环形谐振器设计中参数调控的工程可控性与容差。
AI.method: 采用微磁学模拟分析H-NRR与NRR的透射和反射谱，考察嵌入孔直径、环-波导间隙及环阻尼因子等参数，并用包含前向与后向两条传播路径的解析模型验证。
AI.result: 结果表明H-NRR的谱透射幅度变化对间隙和阻尼呈单调依赖，相比原始NRR具有更好的工程可控性和容差。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的结构与研究可用于传感、数据处理系统和计算等非常规磁振子集成电路的构建。

title: Gapless and Non-Equilibrium Topology in Blockaded Ladders
summary: We propose a multi-leg PXYP model as a minimal setting to explore constraint-induced intertwinement between itinerant and internal degrees of freedom. We argue that the Rydberg-like blockade induces correlations in squeezed space, providing a unified mechanism for nontrivial string order both in and out of equilibrium. In a two-leg geometry, this leads to an intrinsically gapless topological ground state, which can terminate at a supersymmetric multicritical point. This mechanism also leads to the preservation of string order for parametrically long times after a quench, which we verify using tensor network simulations and a classical stochastic approximation to the dynamics. In a three-leg geometry, the blockade leads to an additional emergent $U(1)$ symmetry, resulting in a multicomponent Luttinger liquid where both itinerant and internal degrees of freedom are critical. This family of models arises naturally in a range of quantum simulator platforms such as Rydberg tweezer arrays and dipolar atoms in optical lattices.

AI.tldr: 提出多腿 PXYP 模型作为研究约束诱导巡游自由度与内部自由度纠缠的最小框架，并揭示 Rydberg 型阻塞在压缩空间中诱导关联，从而统一解释平衡与非平衡下的非平凡弦序。
AI.motivation: 探索由约束（特别是 Rydberg 型阻塞）引起的巡游自由度与内部自由度之间的相互纠缠，并寻找可统一描述平衡态拓扑序和非平衡态弦序保持的机制。
AI.method: 构造多腿 PXYP 模型；以 Rydberg 型阻塞诱导压缩空间中的关联为核心机制；结合张量网络模拟与经典随机动力学近似分析淬火后动力学；并讨论两腿与三腿几何下的基态和低能有效理论。
AI.result: 两腿情形下阻塞导致内禀无能隙拓扑基态，并可在超对称多临界点终止；淬火后弦序在参数上很长的时间内保持，得到张量网络模拟和经典随机近似验证。三腿情形下阻塞产生额外涌现 U(1) 对称性，形成多分量 Luttinger 液体，使巡游与内部自由度均处于临界状态。
AI.conclusion: 该模型族提供了约束诱导巡游-内部自由度纠缠的统一机制，可自然出现在 Rydberg 光镊阵列和光晶格中偶极原子等量子模拟平台上。

title: Singlet-Triplet Transition of Rotating Moir\'e Atoms in a Magnetic Field
summary: Moir\'e superlattices can bind several electrons to each potential minimum, forming few-electron "moir\'e atoms." Using neural quantum states that obey magnetic periodic boundary conditions, include full Landau-level mixing, and treat both spin sectors, we map the ground state of two-electron moir\'e atoms in a superlattice as a function of moir\'e depth and magnetic field strength. At strong field each atom is a spin-triplet maximum-density droplet with canonical angular momentum $\langle L_z\rangle=-1$ and a persistent circulating current: the rotating counterpart of the "Wigner molecular crystal" recently imaged in moir\'e superlattices. Deepening the wells drives a singlet-triplet transition to non-rotating spin-singlet atoms whose only current is a weak diamagnetic counter-circulation. The transition moves to deeper wells as the field grows, so depth and field together open a window for the formation of rotors. This is the collective analog of the singlet-triplet transition of two-electron quantum dots. At the transition, the orbital magnetic moments of the atoms reverse sign as their spin polarization switches, a joint signature accessible to magnetometry. If the atoms are instead polarized by other means, such as magnetic proximity coupling, the rotors lock at weak field into a spontaneously ordered crystal of dimers in a pinwheel pattern.

AI.tldr: 利用神经量子态研究双电子莫尔原子，揭示磁场与势阱深度可调控自旋三重态旋转液滴与自旋单态非旋转原子之间的转变，并可形成二聚体风车晶格。
AI.motivation: 理解莫尔超晶格中少数电子“莫尔原子”的磁性与旋转基态，以及其与双电子量子点单-三重态转变的集体类比。
AI.method: 采用满足磁周期性边界条件、包含完整朗道能级混合并同时处理两个自旋扇区的神经量子态，计算双电子莫尔原子基态随莫尔势阱深度和磁场强度的演化。
AI.result: 强场下为自旋三重态最大密度液滴，具有⟨Lz⟩=-1和持续环流；加深势阱触发向非旋转自旋单态的转变，仅存弱抗磁反向环流；转变随磁场增强移向更深势阱，转变处轨道磁矩随自旋极化反转而变号；若通过磁邻近效应等方式预极化，弱场下旋转子锁定为风车状自发有序二聚体晶格。
AI.conclusion: 势阱深度与磁场共同开辟旋转子形成窗口，该现象是双电子量子点单-三重态转变的集体类比，并提供磁强计可探测的轨道磁矩反转信号及自发有序二聚体相。

title: Quantum Monte-Carlo study of spin-valley ferromagnetism in rhombohedral graphene
summary: Recent capacitance measurements in bilayer and trilayer rhombohedral graphene reported large magnetic entropy above the Curie temperature, suggesting the formation of fluctuating local moments. Further experimental support comes from scanning tunneling microscopy experiments in rhombohedral hexalayer graphene, which directly visualized honeycomb electron-crystal order that strengthens upon heating before melting, related to the Pomeranchuk effect. Motivated by these experiments, we construct spin-valley local-moment Hamiltonians for the quarter-metal and half-metal phases. We extract their couplings from constrained Hartree-Fock calculations, and solve their finite-temperature thermodynamics with stochastic-series-expansion quantum Monte Carlo. For the quarter metal we find a continuous 2D-Ising transition at $T_c \approx 0.7$ K, an order of magnitude smaller than the Hartree-Fock estimate (~30 K) and closer to the experimental scale of a few kelvin. For the half metal, we study the field-induced magnetization as a function of temperature with and without proximity-enhanced spin-orbit coupling. When spin-orbit coupling is negligible, intervalley Hund's coupling enhances the magnetic response. Strong spin-orbit coupling, as can be induced by a neighboring transition-metal dichalcogenide, gives rise to the standard spin-canted ground state at zero temperature. Upon heating, the in-plane polarization decreases more rapidly than the out-of-plane polarization. Surprisingly, despite the itinerant nature of the electrons, local-moment models with microscopically determined couplings appear to capture key finite-temperature magnetic properties of rhombohedral graphene without any fitting.

AI.tldr: 受菱形堆叠石墨烯中高于居里温度的大磁熵和加热增强的蜂窝电子晶体实验启发，作者构建自旋-谷局域矩模型并用量子蒙特卡洛求解，发现四分之一金属存在约0.7 K的二维Ising相变，且半金属有限温度磁化可由微观确定耦合的局域矩模型无拟合描述。
AI.motivation: 双层/三层菱形堆叠石墨烯电容测量显示居里温度以上存在大磁熵，暗示涨落局域矩；六层菱形堆叠石墨烯的STM直接观察到加热时增强、熔化前消失的蜂窝电子晶体序，并与Pomeranchuk效应相关。这些实验促使作者研究四分之一金属和半金属相中的有限温度磁性。
AI.method: 作者为四分之一金属和半金属相构建自旋-谷局域矩哈密顿量，通过约束Hartree-Fock计算提取耦合参数，并使用随机级数展开量子蒙特卡洛求解有限温度热力学。对半金属还研究有无邻近增强自旋-轨道耦合时的场致磁化随温度变化。
AI.result: 四分之一金属给出连续二维Ising相变，Tc≈0.7 K，比Hartree-Fock估计的约30 K小一个量级，更接近实验的几K尺度。半金属中，自旋-轨道耦合可忽略时谷间Hund耦合增强磁响应；强自旋-轨道耦合（如邻近过渡金属二硫族化物诱导）在零温产生标准自旋倾斜基态，升温时面内极化比面外极化下降更快。
AI.conclusion: 尽管电子具有巡游性，采用微观确定耦合的局域矩模型无需拟合即可捕捉菱形堆叠石墨烯的关键有限温度磁性质，支持局域矩图像对该体系磁性的适用性。

title: Triplon thermal Hall response in a honeycomb-lattice $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg antiferromagnet with Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interactions
summary: We investigate triplon topology and the thermal Hall transport in a columnar valence-bond solid of a spin-$1/2$ honeycomb-lattice $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg antiferromagnet. Inequivalent triangular sublattices, modeled by $J_2^A\neq J_2^B$, remove inversion symmetry at nearest-neighbor bond centers and allow in-plane Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya (DM) interactions. We identify the two symmetry-allowed in-plane DM vector patterns and present detailed results for the pattern parallel to the bonds including an out-of-plane magnetic field. Within a harmonic bond-operator treatment, we determine the triplon bands, their Berry curvatures and Chern numbers, and the triplon thermal Hall conductivity. The DM interaction and magnetic field generate nonzero Berry curvatures, but the numerically integrated Chern number of every isolated triplon band vanishes. Nevertheless, the energy-dependent Bose weighting of positive and negative Berry-curvature regions produces a finite thermal Hall response at nonzero low temperatures. We delimit the dilute-triplon regime in which the harmonic transport calculation is expected to be reliable. These results show that a vanishing Chern number band does not directly constrain the triplon response of a valence-bond solid. We also comment on the effects on the columnar valence-bond solid phase of a DM interaction between next-nearest-neighbor spins characterized by an out-of-plane vector pattern.

AI.tldr: 研究自旋-1/2蜂窝晶格J1-J2海森堡反铁磁体柱状价键固体中的三聚子拓扑与热霍尔输运，发现即使各孤立三聚子带的陈数均为零，低温下贝里曲率的能量依赖玻色权重仍可产生有限热霍尔响应。
AI.motivation: 探究价键固体中三聚子拓扑如何影响热霍尔输运，并检验陈数是否直接约束三聚子响应；不等价三角子晶格J2^A≠J2^B破坏最近邻键中心反演对称性，从而允许面内Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用。
AI.method: 在简谐键算符框架下，确定两种对称允许的面内DM矢量模式，并详细研究平行于键的模式及外加面外磁场；计算三聚子能带、贝里曲率、陈数和三聚子热霍尔电导率，并界定简谐输运计算可靠的稀薄三聚子区域；同时讨论次近邻自旋间面外DM矢量模式对柱状价键固体相的影响。
AI.result: DM相互作用与磁场产生非零贝里曲率，但每个孤立三聚子带的数值积分陈数均为零；然而正负贝里曲率区域的能量依赖玻色权重在非零低温下导致有限热霍尔响应；给出了稀薄三聚子区域，并表明陈数为零的能带并不直接限制价键固体的三聚子响应。
AI.conclusion: 柱状价键固体中的三聚子热霍尔效应可在净陈数为零时出现，源于补偿的贝里曲率与玻色统计权重的共同作用；仅凭陈数不足以判断三聚子热响应，需考虑能带分辨的贝里曲率分布及温度相关的玻色占据。

title: Exact Electron Dynamics in Linear and Chiral Cavities: Complete Field versus Single-Helicity Reduction
summary: Can a chiral cavity turn a free electron into a Landau-like orbiting particle? We answer with exact solutions of three quadratic electron--cavity models in the dipole limit, valid at arbitrary coupling. A single linearly polarized mode dresses the electron mass, which delays its flight, slows the spreading of a wavepacket and entangles the packet with the cavity. The complete transverse field, with both circular helicities, keeps two commuting, gapless translations at any coupling, mode number and helicity splitting, so the electron stays ballistic and no synthetic magnetic field appears. Keeping a single helicity gives two inequivalent models that are not related by a gauge transformation: reducing before the Power--Zienau--Woolley transformation gives ballistic motion, whereas reducing after it gives a Landau-like crossed-quadrature Hamiltonian. They differ by a real uniform field $B=s\lambda^2/(2\omega_c)$ ($\omega_c$ the mode frequency, $\lambda$ the coupling, $s=\pm1$ the helicity). In the complete theory the frequency $\omega_{-s}$ of the partner helicity, measured against $g^2=\lambda^2/(2\omega_c)$, decides between them: the electron is ballistic for a stiff partner, and Landau-like only at the soft-partner point, through an exact canonical reorganization that holds for the active sector but not for observables such as the electron--photon entanglement. Projecting onto one helicity after the PZW transformation is therefore not by itself a mechanism for synthetic magnetism; the mode content of the cavity is.

AI.tldr: 手性腔不能仅靠保留单一螺旋度并做PZW投影来产生合成磁场；电子是否呈现Landau类轨道运动取决于腔模内容及伙伴螺旋度的软硬。
AI.motivation: 检验“手性腔能否把自由电子变成Landau类轨道粒子”这一设想，并厘清单螺旋度投影、PZW变换顺序与合成规范场之间的关系。
AI.method: 在偶极近似下精确求解三个二次型电子-腔模型，适用于任意耦合；比较线偏振单模、包含两种圆偏振螺旋度的完整横向场，以及保留单一螺旋度时在PZW变换前后约化的模型。
AI.result: 单线偏振模使电子质量重整化，延迟飞行、减慢波包扩散并使波包与腔纠缠；完整双螺旋度场在任意耦合、模数和螺旋度劈裂下保持两个对易无隙平移，电子保持弹道运动且无合成磁场。单螺旋度给出两个非规范等价模型：PZW前约化为弹道运动，PZW后约化为Landau类交叉正交哈密顿量，二者相差均匀场 B=sλ^2/(2ω_c)。完整理论中伙伴螺旋度频率 ω_{-s} 与 g^2=λ^2/(2ω_c) 的比较决定取舍：硬伙伴对应弹道，仅在软伙伴点出现Landau类行为；该精确正则重组只对活跃扇区成立，对电子-光子纠缠等可观测量不成立。
AI.conclusion: PZW变换后投影到单一螺旋度本身不是合成磁性的机制；关键是腔的模内容。只有特定伙伴螺旋度条件下才可出现Landau类行为，且不能据此一般性地定义合成磁场或可观测量。

title: Electron-electron interactions mediated by overdamped vibrations: Implications for chirality-induced spin selectivity
summary: Motivated by chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS), we investigate spin polarization during molecular electron transfer through a correlated bridge in the presence of a rapidly relaxing Peierls mode. By modulating both electronic hopping and spin--orbit coupling, the mode mediates two-body spin-spin interactions, including isotropic, anisotropic, and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya exchange. We derive these interactions using an exact Lang-Firsov transformation for a four-site chiral bridge. We then include fast vibrational relaxation in the joint electron--vibration master equation and derive the reduced electronic dynamics to second order in the vibronic coupling, retaining both coherent and dissipative contributions and the finite-time buildup of the vibrational response. We test our derivation by numerical simulations, finding spin polarization accumulated at the acceptor after unpolarized injection, with nonmonotonic dependence on damping and bridge filling. Within the postulated local-loss model, our results show that rapid vibrational relaxation does not preclude spin polarization through a correlated bridge and provide a framework for assessing vibration-mediated interactions and dissipative dynamics as ingredients of CISS in molecular electron transfer.

AI.tldr: 研究快速弛豫Peierls声子模式下相关分子桥中的电子转移自旋极化，揭示振动介导的自旋-自旋相互作用与耗散动力学如何影响CISS。
AI.motivation: 受手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）启发，探究分子电子转移通过相关桥时，在快速弛豫Peierls模式存在下能否产生自旋极化。
AI.method: 考虑Peierls模式同时调制电子跃迁和自旋-轨道耦合，产生各向同性、各向异性及Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya型两体自旋-自旋相互作用；对四站点手性桥采用精确Lang-Firsov变换推导这些相互作用，并在联合电子-振动主方程中加入快速振动弛豫，二阶展开获得约化电子动力学，保留相干与耗散贡献及振动响应的有限时间建立过程。
AI.result: 数值模拟验证推导，发现无极化注入后在受体处积累自旋极化，且其依赖于阻尼和桥占据数呈非单调关系。
AI.conclusion: 在所设局部损失模型下，快速振动弛豫并不排除通过相关桥实现自旋极化；该框架可用于评估振动介导相互作用和耗散动力学作为分子电子转移中CISS的组成要素。

title: Frustration-Induced $1/6$-Vortex-Paired Phase in a Kagome XY Model
summary: Geometric frustration can fractionalize vortices in two-dimensional XY systems, but a given frustrated model usually hosts only a single type of fractional vortex. Here we study a kagome XY model in which an antiferromagnetic coupling $J_1$ and a second-harmonic coupling $K$ favor two competing frustrated ground-state manifolds. For $K/J_1<1/9$, the ground states map onto those of the kagome three-state Potts antiferromagnet and support $1/3$ vortices; for $K/J_1>1/9$, they map onto those of the kagome Ising antiferromagnet and support $1/2$ vortices. At $K/J_1=1/9$, the two manifolds become degenerate, and bends in the domain walls between them carry $1/6$-vortex excitations. Tensor-network calculations show that a finite-temperature phase with quasi-long-range order only in $e^{6i\theta}$ emerges from this degenerate point, separating the $1/3$- and $1/2$-vortex-paired phases. This $1/6$-vortex-paired phase has no counterpart in either parent manifold, showing that competing frustrated manifolds provide a route to new fractional-vortex-paired phases.

AI.tldr: 在kagome XY模型中，通过调节反铁磁耦合J1与二次谐波耦合K的比值，使两个竞争阻挫基态流形在K/J1=1/9处简并，从而产生由1/6分数涡旋配对的新有限温度相。
AI.motivation: 几何阻挫可在二维XY系统中实现涡旋分数化，但通常一个阻挫模型只支持单一类型的分数涡旋；作者希望利用两个竞争阻挫基态流形的简并来获得新的分数涡旋配对相。
AI.method: 研究具有反铁磁耦合J1和二次谐波耦合K的kagome XY模型；分析不同K/J1下的基态映射与涡旋激发，并在简并点附近使用张量网络计算有限温度相图与准长程序。
AI.result: 当K/J1<1/9时基态映射到kagome三态Potts反铁磁体并支持1/3涡旋；当K/J1>1/9时映射到kagome Ising反铁磁体并支持1/2涡旋；在K/J1=1/9处两流形简并，其畴壁弯折携带1/6涡旋激发。张量网络显示从该简并点涌现出一个仅在e^{6iθ}具有准长程序的有限温度相，并分隔1/3涡旋配对相与1/2涡旋配对相。
AI.conclusion: 该1/6涡旋配对相在两个母流形中均无对应，表明竞争阻挫流形可作为一种设计新分数涡旋配对相的机制。

title: Counting kinks and magnons with the lattice: magnetoelastic effects in Cs$_2$CoBr$_4$
summary: We report low-temperature dilatometry and ultrasound measurements on the frustrated quasi-one-dimensional antiferromagnet Cs$_2$CoBr$_4$ across the entire cascade of field-induced magnetic phase transitions. The whole phase diagram can be recovered from these lattice probes, with distinct anomalies observed at each phase boundary. Elongation along the principal chain axis is found to closely track magnetization throughout the phase diagram. This behavior is interpreted in terms of kinks in the N\'eel structure and magnons in the transverse-ordered magnetic-BEC phases, each carrying a fixed lattice distortion. A simultaneous analysis of ultrasound and striction data allows us to quantify the strength of magnetoelastic coupling.

AI.tldr: 利用低温膨胀测量和超声测量重建了受挫准一维反铁磁体Cs2CoBr4在整个场致磁相变级联中的相图，发现链轴伸长与磁化强度密切跟随，并量化了磁弹耦合强度。
AI.motivation: Cs2CoBr4具有受挫准一维反铁磁性及丰富的场致磁相变，需要从晶格响应角度理解磁相边界、磁化行为与磁弹耦合。
AI.method: 在低温下对Cs2CoBr4进行膨胀测量和超声测量，覆盖全部场致磁相变；将链轴伸长与磁化强度对比，并用Néel结构中的kink及横向有序磁BEC相中的magnon各自携带固定晶格畸变来解释，同时联合分析超声与strict ion数据。
AI.result: 所有磁相边界均可在晶格探针中观测到明显异常，从而恢复完整相图；沿主链方向的伸长在整个相图中紧密跟随磁化强度；联合超声与strict ion数据可定量给出磁弹耦合强度。
AI.conclusion: 晶格探针可有效追踪场致磁相变，链轴伸长与磁化的对应可由携带固定晶格畸变的kink和magnon激发解释，Cs2CoBr4中存在可量化的磁弹耦合。

title: Solvable coupled cluster states in $d=\infty$ with prescribed momentum distribution
summary: Two of the most successful ideas in many-body theory, the exponential coupled cluster ansatz and DMFT, have to date developed separately. We establish a connection between them, by showing that the infinite dimensional limit of the hypercubic lattice allows the exact closed-form evaluation of static expectation values of coupled cluster wave functions, provided the cluster amplitudes admit a low-rank decomposition. As a result, evaluation errors -- a serious concern in conventional coupled cluster theory -- can be disentangled from limitations to expressivity of coupled cluster states. For this family of coupled cluster states, the cavity construction in $d\to\infty$ exactly reduces the environment of a lattice site to a Gaussian Grassmann kernel, and irreducible diagrams for one-body expectation values are found to be site-diagonal (in analogy to the DMFT self-energy). The resulting ``impurity problem" is an integral over a finite number of Grassmann variables rather than a dynamical quantum impurity problem, so that static observables derive exactly from a static self-consistency condition: a wave function counterpart of DMFT. For the simplest case of a cluster amplitude restricted to rank-one doubles, we obtain the momentum distribution in closed form. We show that any momentum distribution can be realized by a state that is the exact and unique ground state of an explicit parent Hamiltonian with a gapless single-particle tunnelling spectrum. By construction these coupled cluster states variationally recover low order perturbation theory for the Hubbard model. Their failure in the strong coupling regime near the Mott transition diagnoses a fundamental limitation of coupled cluster doubles. Intriguingly, our family of coupled cluster wave functions includes a gapless state with zero quasiparticle weight, with a momentum distribution that is completely smooth at the Fermi energy.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了指数耦合簇（coupled cluster）拟设与DMFT之间的联系：在无限维超立方晶格极限下，若簇振幅可低秩分解，则可精确闭式求静态期望值，并由此构造DMFT的波函数对应物。
AI.motivation: 耦合簇与DMFT是多体理论中两个成功但长期独立发展的框架；作者希望建立二者联系，并区分耦合簇中的评估误差与状态表达能力限制。
AI.method: 利用超立方晶格 d→∞ 极限，对具有低秩簇振幅的耦合簇波函数精确计算静态期望值；通过腔构造将格点环境严格约化为高斯Grassmann核，证明单体积分期望值的不可约图是格点对角的，类似DMFT自能；由此得到有限Grassmann变量上的“杂质问题”和静态自洽条件。对秩一 doubles 情形给出动量分布闭式；并构造显式母Hamiltonian分析基态唯一性与单粒子隧穿谱。
AI.result: 得到耦合簇波函数的静态DMFT式自洽描述；任意动量分布都可由某个显式母Hamiltonian的唯一精确基态实现，且该Hamiltonian具有无隙单粒子隧穿谱；该类状态变分上可恢复Hubbard模型低阶微扰论；在Mott转变附近强耦合区失效，揭示coupled cluster doubles的根本限制；还发现一类无隙、零准粒子权重且动量分布在Fermi能处完全光滑的状态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将耦合簇与DMFT统一在一个可精确求解的无限维框架下，提供DMFT的波函数对应物，并用于诊断耦合簇拟设的表达能力与失效机制。

title: Anomalies of TQFTs coupled to parameter spaces and constraints on ground-state degeneracies
summary: Anomalies of global symmetries can arise in long-range entangled quantum many-body systems and provide useful constraints on their dynamics. In this paper, we study anomalies of $d$-dimensional topological quantum field theories (TQFTs) coupled to parameter spaces and their implications for ground-state degeneracies. Specifically, we formulate anomalies as obstructions to constructing parametrized families of TQFTs. We discuss how the classification of these anomalies depends on the choice of topology on the universal $\mathrm{U}(1)$ $(d-1)$-form symmetry. In this framework, we use the projective ground-state bundle obtained by compactifying the TQFT on a spatial manifold to derive a general constraint relating its ground-state degeneracy $N$ to its torsion anomaly $\omega$, expressed as $N\int_W\omega\in\mathbb{Z}$ for bundles $W$ of spatial manifolds over closed surfaces. We apply this constraint to ground-state degeneracies of (2+1)-dimensional TQFTs with framing and 1-form symmetry anomalies and to obstructions to symmetry-preserving TQFTs. We also discuss implications for bordism generators and propose a conjecture on anomaly detection by manifolds fibered over surfaces.

AI.tldr: 该文将拓扑量子场论（TQFT）与参数空间耦合时的异常表述为构造参数化 TQFT 族的障碍，并导出基态简并度 N 与挠异常 ω 的普遍约束 N∫_W ω∈ℤ。
AI.motivation: 长程纠缠量子多体系统中整体对称性异常可约束动力学；本文旨在系统研究 d 维 TQFT 耦合参数空间时的异常及其对基态简并度的影响。
AI.method: 把异常视为构造参数化 TQFT 族的障碍；讨论异常分类对 universal U(1) (d−1)-form 对称性所选拓扑的依赖；通过在空间流形上紧致化 TQFT 得到投影基态丛，并据此推导联系基态简并度 N 与挠异常 ω 的约束。
AI.result: 得到对闭曲面上空间流形丛 W 的约束 N∫_W ω∈ℤ；将其应用于带 framing 和 1-form 对称性异常的 (2+1) 维 TQFT 的基态简并度，以及保持对称性的 TQFT 的存在障碍。
AI.conclusion: 作者讨论了该框架对 bordism 生成元的含义，并提出一个关于用纤维化在曲面上的流形检测异常的猜想。

title: Charge Pumping Leptogenesis from the Symmetric Mass Generation Phase on a Four-Leg Ladder Lattice
summary: Quantized charge pumping in quantum Hall systems is a bulk topological property, typically manifesting on gapless boundaries as spectral flow through chiral edge modes upon flux insertion. When the boundary is anomaly-free, it can be symmetrically gapped by symmetric mass generation (SMG) interactions. However, the effects on quantized charge pumping at an interacting gapped boundary are unclear. We address this using density-matrix renormalization group simulations of a four-leg ladder quasi-(2+1)d realization of the (1+1)d 3-4-5-0 lattice chiral fermion model with six-fermion interactions at one edge. We find gapless modes near the interacting edge for both weak and strong couplings, but the edge can be in a fully gapped SMG phase at intermediate coupling. We also identify spontaneous breaking of the model's $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry above a critical interaction strength. Across all three boundary phases, we find quantized charge pumping with the same pumped charge per flux quantum. The spatial distribution of the pumped charge varies between phases. Besides charge pumping, we study how a single injected fermion propagates under open boundary conditions. In the SMG phase, an interaction-induced flavor-mixing current develops at the endpoints of the gapped edge, which is absent in the weak- and strong-coupling limits. This current reveals a charge-redistribution mechanism unique to the SMG phase. Additionally, we propose an analogy between charge pumping in this model and a topological leptogenesis scenario in the (3+1)d Standard Model. The anomaly-free chiral U(1) symmetries of the 3-4-5-0 model play a role analogous to the baryon-minus-lepton symmetry of the Standard Model. In both settings, charge pumping can be associated with a continuous deformation along a classically defined but quantum-anomalous direction, while a discrete subgroup remains an exact quantum symmetry.

AI.tldr: 该文用DMRG研究四腿梯形中(1+1)d 3-4-5-0手征费米子模型单边六费米子相互作用下的量子化电荷泵浦，发现弱/强耦合边缘无能隙、中间耦合可进入完全能隙的对称质量生成(SMG)相，且三种边缘相均保持相同的每磁通量子泵浦电荷。
AI.motivation: 量子Hall系统中量子化电荷泵浦通常由无能隙手征边缘模的谱流体现；当边缘无反常时，可由对称质量生成相互作用对称地打开能隙，但这种相互作用能隙边缘对量子化电荷泵浦的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对(1+1)d 3-4-5-0格点手征费米子模型的准(2+1)d四腿梯形实现进行密度矩阵重整化群(DMRG)模拟，并在一条边缘引入六费米子相互作用；同时研究单费米子注入在开边界条件下的传播。
AI.result: 发现弱、强耦合下相互作用边缘附近存在无能隙模，而中间耦合可形成完全能隙的SMG相；超过临界相互作用强度出现模型Z2对称性的自发破缺。三种边界相均表现出量子化电荷泵浦，且每磁通量子泵浦电荷相同，但泵浦电荷的空间分布随相变化。在SMG相中，能隙边缘端点出现相互作用诱导的味混合流，弱、强耦合极限下不存在，揭示SMG相特有的电荷重分布机制。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明无反常边缘即使被SMG相互作用完全能隙化，量子化电荷泵浦仍可保持，但其空间分布和边缘输运细节可因相互作用相而改变；作者进一步将该模型中的电荷泵浦与(3+1)d标准模型拓扑轻子生成类比，3-4-5-0模型的无反常手征U(1)对称性类似B-L对称性，泵浦对应沿经典定义但量子反常方向的连续形变，而离散子群仍为精确量子对称性。

title: Resolving the spinon hierarchy of the Heisenberg antiferromagnet
summary: A local spin fluctuation in the spin-$\tfrac12$ Heisenberg antiferromagnet creates an even number of fractional spinon excitations. We resolve its zero-temperature dynamical structure factor through six spinons directly in the thermodynamic limit. Beyond the established two-spinon contribution of $72.89\%$, the four-spinon response gives approximately $21.90\%$ of the integrated intensity and six spinons contribute a further $4.3\%$, bringing the response to about $99\%$ of both the intensity and first-frequency-moment sum rules. We derive momentum-independent first-moment fractions in the calculated sectors and a general upper-edge law $S_n\sim A_n(k)(\omega_{n,u}-\omega)^{(n^2-3)/2}$ for every even $n$ at nonzero momentum. The rapid growth of the edge exponent explains why the expanding multiparticle bandwidth carries very little high-energy weight, while higher sectors remain appreciable within the lower-sector continua.

AI.tldr: 该文在热力学极限下将自旋1/2海森堡反铁磁体的零温动力学结构因子解析到六自旋子，并给出多自旋子谱重、求和规则与谱边缘幂律。
AI.motivation: 局域自旋涨落产生偶数个分数化自旋子；需要定量理解两自旋子之外的四自旋子和六自旋子贡献，以及多粒子连续谱中的高能谱重分布。
AI.method: 对自旋1/2海森堡反铁磁体，在热力学极限下直接计算零温动力学结构因子并分解到六自旋子扇区；检验强度与第一频率矩求和规则，推导非零动量下每个偶数n的上边缘律 S_n∼A_n(k)(ω_{n,u}-ω)^{(n^2-3)/2}。
AI.result: 两自旋子贡献为72.89%，四自旋子约21.90%，六自旋子再贡献4.3%，使强度和第一频率矩求和规则均达到约99%；得到所计算扇区中动量无关的第一矩分数；边缘指数快速增长解释了扩张的多粒子带宽只携带很少高能权重，而更高扇区在下扇区连续谱内仍显著。
AI.conclusion: 多自旋子贡献不可忽略，六自旋子已使求和规则近乎饱和；上边缘幂律控制谱重分布，并给出高能尾部被抑制的机制。

title: Electron Scattering with ASTRA: Helium and Molecular Hydrogen
summary: We present an implementation of electron-impact scattering in ASTRA, a close-coupling method based on transition density matrices previously applied to molecular photoionization. The scattering states are obtained with a pole-free Galerkin method with variational surface matching, which yields the scattering matrix and the channel-resolved amplitudes for elastic and electronically inelastic integral cross sections and molecular-frame differential cross sections. For helium, ASTRA reproduces elastic and inelastic cross sections over a broad energy range, resolves the He$^-$(1s2s$^2$ $^2$S$^e$) Feshbach resonance in both energy and angle, and captures the principal interference structures in the n=2 excitation angular distributions, in selected channels matching measured differential-cross-section ratios more closely than available benchmark calculations. For molecular hydrogen, target polarization and interchannel coupling are represented through additional close-coupling channels, without a fitted polarization potential or a separately constructed (N+1)-electron correlation space. Compared with the restricted-channel description, the expanded calculations substantially improve agreement with UKRmol+ for elastic and inelastic cross sections. We further report fully orientation-resolved three-dimensional molecular-frame angular distributions for state-resolved electron-impact excitation. These reveal pronounced stereodynamic effects that vanish upon orientational averaging: at 15 eV, excitation of the b$^3\Sigma_u^+$ state is more than eight times stronger for incident momentum parallel rather than perpendicular to the molecular axis. These results connect conventional scattering benchmarks with orientation-resolved collision dynamics and open the way to larger molecular targets.

AI.tldr: 作者在ASTRA中实现了基于跃迁密度矩阵的电子碰撞散射计算，可给出弹性和电子非弹性积分截面及分子坐标系微分截面，并揭示取向分辨的立体动力学效应。
AI.motivation: 将先前用于分子光电离的close-coupling框架推广到电子-分子散射，避免经验极化势和单独构造(N+1)电子相关空间，并连接常规散射基准与取向分辨碰撞动力学。
AI.method: 采用无极点Galerkin方法结合变分表面匹配获得散射态、散射矩阵和通道分辨振幅；对H2通过增加close-coupling通道表示目标极化和通道间耦合。
AI.result: 对He在宽能区重现弹性和非弹性截面，在能量和角度上解析He^-(1s2s^2 ^2S^e) Feshbach共振，并捕获n=2激发角分布的主要干涉结构；对H2扩展通道计算显著改善与UKRmol+的弹性和非弹性截面一致性；给出态分辨、完全取向分辨的三维分子坐标系角分布，发现在15 eV下b^3\Sigma_u^+态在入射动量平行分子轴时比垂直时激发强8倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了从传统散射基准到取向分辨碰撞动力学的桥梁，并为进一步处理更大分子靶体系提供了可行途径。

title: Physical Mechanisms of Light-Induced Molecular Fragmentation in the Long-Wavelength Regime
summary: Strong near-infrared (NIR) laser fields ionize polyatomic molecules through tunneling and multiphoton processes, while subsequent molecular fragmentation can be driven by electron rescattering and field-induced nonadiabatic excitation of the molecular ion. How these competing mechanisms deposit energy into molecular ions and determine fragmentation branching remains unresolved. By combining wavelength- and ellipticity-dependent intensity-difference mass spectrometry of methanol with time-dependent Schr\"odinger equation (TDSE) and semiclassical Monte Carlo simulations, we demonstrate that, in the tunneling-to-intermediate regime ($\gamma \lesssim 1$), molecular fragmentation is governed by the interplay of electron recollision and field-driven nonadiabatic excitation, revealing competing physical mechanisms relevant to polyatomic molecules more broadly. Ellipticity-dependent measurements demonstrate that these mechanisms can be experimentally distinguished for individual cationic fragments. Channels requiring high internal energies exhibit the strong ellipticity-dependent suppression characteristic of rescattering-driven processes, while lower-energy channels are comparatively less sensitive. Although small-fragment yields decrease substantially with increasing wavelength, their relative distributions remain largely unchanged, indicating that the underlying fragmentation pathways are preserved and that the suppression primarily reflects reduced probabilities of electron recollision and nonadiabatic excitations at longer wavelengths.

AI.tldr: 该文结合甲醇的波长/椭偏度依赖强度差质谱、TDSE 与半经典 Monte Carlo 模拟，表明在隧穿至中间区（γ≲1）多原子分子碎裂由电子回碰与场驱动非绝热激发共同竞争决定。
AI.motivation: 强近红外激光电离多原子分子后，电子回碰与场诱导非绝热激发如何向分子离子沉积能量并决定碎裂分支尚不清楚，需区分这些竞争机制。
AI.method: 对甲醇开展波长和椭偏度依赖的强度差质谱测量，并联合求解含时薛定谔方程（TDSE）及半经典 Monte Carlo 模拟，分析不同阳离子碎片的产率与椭偏度/波长响应。
AI.result: 在 γ≲1 的隧穿至中间区，碎裂由电子回碰和场驱动非绝热激发共同控制；椭偏度测量可在单个阳离子碎片通道上区分机制：需高内能的通道随椭偏度显著抑制，符合回碰驱动特征，低能通道较不敏感；波长增大使小碎片产率下降，但相对分布基本不变，表明碎裂路径保持，抑制主要源于回碰与非绝热激发概率降低。
AI.conclusion: 多原子分子强场碎裂由电子回碰与场驱动非绝热激发竞争主导，椭偏度依赖可实验区分具体碎片通道；该机制框架对更广泛多原子分子具有相关性。

title: Atomistic Emergence of Vibrational Polariton Condensation
summary: Nonequilibrium polariton condensation is a macroscopic quantum phenomenon in which overwhelming population accumulation is observed at the band edge of the lower polariton (LP) dispersion curve under incoherent material pumping. As a promising route toward nonequilibrium Bose--Einstein condensates, its description, however, remains predominantly limited to models with phenomenological material parameters. Herein, a fully atomistic description of vibrational polariton condensation is developed by employing mesoscale cavity molecular dynamics simulations, a method which self-consistently propagates classical electromagnetic dynamics coupled to realistic molecules in a multimode Fabry--P\'erot cavity. Under continuous-wave pumping, a lower polariton condensate forms when the infrared cavity is coupled to harmonic, homogeneously broadened molecular vibrations, such as the bending modes of liquid CO2 and CS2, whereas anharmonic stretching modes and liquids with fast intramolecular relaxation hardly condense. The role of libration-bending coupling for facilitating the LP condensation is further discussed. GPU-accelerated mesoscale simulations involving approximately 50 million atoms additionally provide direct two-dimensional real-space imaging of fluid-like polariton patterns during the condensation formation. Overall, this study provides key design insights into vibrational polariton condensation as a novel approach for controlling liquid-phase chemistry.

AI.tldr: 该工作用介观腔分子动力学对振动极化激元凝聚给出全原子描述，揭示谐性、均匀展宽的弯曲振动模易实现连续波泵浦下的下极化激元凝聚，并给出流体状极化激元图案的实空间成像。
AI.motivation: 非平衡极化激元凝聚是重要的宏观量子现象，但现有描述多依赖唯象材料参数，缺乏对真实分子振动与腔场耦合的全原子层面理解。
AI.method: 采用GPU加速的介观腔分子动力学模拟，约5000万原子体系，自洽传播多模Fabry–Pérot腔中经典电磁动力学与真实分子的耦合，并在连续波泵浦下研究振动极化激元凝聚。
AI.result: 当红外腔与谐性、均匀展宽的分子振动耦合时，可形成下极化激元凝聚，如液态CO2和CS2的弯曲模；非谐伸缩模及具有快速分子内弛豫的液体难以凝聚；并讨论libration–bending耦合对促进LP凝聚的作用，同时获得凝聚形成过程中流体状极化激元图案的二维实空间成像。
AI.conclusion: 研究为振动极化激元凝聚提供了关键设计准则，并表明其可作为控制液相化学的新途径。

title: Streptavidin-Biotin Binding is Intrinsically Non-Cooperative, but Experimental Artefacts Can Induce Apparent Positive Cooperativity
summary: The biotin-streptavidin interaction is a key component of nanobiotechnology, yet the nature of its cooperativity remains a debated question. Here, we introduce a label-free spectroscopy approach based on confocal UV autofluorescence microscopy to probe the binding cooperativity of this high-affinity system. By leveraging the intrinsic autofluorescence of tryptophan residues, we avoid artefacts associated with extrinsic fluorescent labels, enabling precise measurements of fully biotin-saturated streptavidin across a wide range of molar ratios. Our experimental results, supported by Monte Carlo simulations, provide conclusive evidence for the absence of cooperativity. However, we show that false signs of apparent positive cooperativity can emerge from local concentration inhomogeneities occurring when rapid reaction kinetics outpace mixing. By establishing the non-cooperative nature of biotin-streptavidin binding and identifying the key conditions to avoid cooperativity artefacts, these insights resolve a longstanding debate and offer critical implications for streptavidin-based biotechnological applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用基于色氨酸内源自发荧光的无标记共聚焦紫外自发荧光显微光谱技术，结合蒙特卡洛模拟，证明生物素-链霉亲和素结合不存在协同性，并揭示混合不充分可导致假阳性协同性信号。
AI.motivation: 生物素-链霉亲和素相互作用是纳米生物技术的重要组成部分，但其是否具有协同性长期存在争议；同时外源荧光标记可能引入伪影，需要无标记方法精确探测该高亲和体系的结合协同性。
AI.method: 采用共聚焦紫外自发荧光显微光谱，利用色氨酸残基的内源自发荧光实现无标记检测，在宽摩尔比范围内测量完全被生物素饱和的链霉亲和素；并用蒙特卡洛模拟支持实验解释。
AI.result: 实验结果与蒙特卡洛模拟一致，确证生物素-链霉亲和素结合无协同性；但当快速反应动力学超过混合速度时，局部浓度不均匀会产生表观正协同性的假信号。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了生物素-链霉亲和素结合的非协同本质，识别了避免协同性伪影的关键条件，从而解决长期争议，并对基于链霉亲和素的生物技术应用具有重要指导意义。

title: A Hybrid Message-Passing and Electric-Field Representation for Electrostatic QM/MM Embedding with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Within a hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics approach a small region of a large atomistic system is described quantum mechanically, while the rest of the system is represented by a classical force field. Despite this, the computational cost of the quantum calculation severely limits the accessible simulation and sampling time. Replacing the quantum calculation with a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) trained on quantum reference data can greatly increase the accessible simulation time. However, the accuracy and efficiency strongly depend on the specific way in which the MLIP incorporates information about the classical (electrostatic) environment. Here, we demonstrate that existing strategies based purely on features derived from an external electric field fail to distinguish certain environments, ultimately limiting their accuracy. As a solution, we propose an extension to the equivariant TensorNet architecture that mitigates this shortcoming by incorporating classical atoms close to the quantum region into the message-passing scheme, combined with features derived from the electric field for describing the environment farther away. We show that this combination achieves higher accuracy than either approach alone.

AI.tldr: 在QM/MM模拟中，用机器学习原子间势替代量子计算可延长模拟时间，但关键在于如何准确描述经典静电环境；作者提出结合近区经典原子消息传递与远区电场特征的TensorNet扩展，提高了精度。
AI.motivation: QM/MM中量子区域计算成本高，限制模拟与采样时间；用基于量子参考数据的MLIP替代量子计算可加速，但现有仅依赖外部电场特征的策略无法区分某些环境，限制精度。
AI.method: 提出对等变TensorNet架构的扩展：将靠近量子区域的经典原子纳入消息传递方案，同时用外部电场派生特征描述更远处的环境。
AI.result: 该组合策略比单独使用经典原子消息传递或单独使用电场特征获得更高精度，并能区分仅靠电场特征无法区分的环境。
AI.conclusion: 将近区经典原子显式纳入等变MLIP的消息传递并结合远区电场特征，是提升QM/MM机器学习势精度和描述静电环境能力的有效方案。

title: Surface Hopping Dynamics on Adiabatic States Propagated with Real-Time TDDFT
summary: Real-time time-dependent density functional theory (RT-TDDFT) is widely used to simulate ultrafast electron dynamics, but it is usually coupled to the nuclei through the mean-field Ehrenfest approximation, which cannot describe wavepacket branching and violates detailed balance. Surface hopping avoids these problems, but has not previously been combined with RT-TDDFT because real-time propagation does not directly provide the necessary adiabatic states. In this work we introduce an energy-scaled time-dependent Kohn--Sham (TDKS) propagation scheme, motivated by the quantum adiabatic theorem. Scaling widens the separation between electronic and nuclear timescales, so that each propagated state follows the adiabatic surface selected by its initial condition: either the ground state or a non-Aufbau self-consistent-field ($\Delta$SCF) solution. The propagation thereby avoids the convergence failures of static SCF solvers in regions of strong nonadiabatic coupling. Because the independently propagated states are complex-valued and not mutually orthogonal, we reformulate the mapping approach to surface hopping (MASH) in a complex adiabatic basis and introduce a dynamical transition orbital (DTO) gauge that restores a well-defined particle--hole representation for evaluating time-derivative couplings and nonadiabatic coupling vectors. Applied to the photoisomerization of \textit{trans}-diimide, the scheme converges systematically as the scaling factor is increased and yields an excited-state lifetime in good agreement with previous nonadiabatic simulations based on static SCF.\@ These results establish real-time propagation as an efficient and numerically stable route to the adiabatic states and couplings required for first-principles surface hopping.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出能量缩放的时间相关 Kohn–Sham 传播方案，将 RT-TDDFT 与表面跳跃结合，以克服 Ehrenfest 近似无法描述波包分支和违反细致平衡的问题，并在 trans-diimide 光异构化中验证。
AI.motivation: RT-TDDFT 常用于模拟超快电子动力学，但通常通过平均场 Ehrenfest 近似耦合原子核，无法描述波包分支且违反细致平衡；表面跳跃可避免这些问题，但此前难以与 RT-TDDFT 结合，因为实时传播不直接提供所需的绝热态。
AI.method: 受量子绝热定理启发，引入能量缩放的时间相关 Kohn–Sham 传播，使电子与核时间尺度分离，让每个传播态沿其初态选择的绝热面演化（基态或非 Aufbau 的 ΔSCF 解），从而避免强非绝热耦合区域中静态 SCF 求解器的收敛失败。由于独立传播态为复值且彼此不正交，作者在复绝热基中重新表述 MASH，并引入动力学跃迁轨道规范，以恢复定义明确的粒子–空穴表示来评估时间导数耦合和非绝热耦合矢量。
AI.result: 应用于 trans-diimide 光异构化时，该方案随缩放因子增大而系统收敛，并给出与先前基于静态 SCF 的非绝热模拟良好一致的激发态寿命。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了实时传播作为获取第一性原理表面跳跃所需绝热态和耦合的高效、数值稳定途径。

title: The Role of Electron-Nuclear Coupling on Chemical and Physical Processes
summary: Over the last few decades, Born-Oppenheimer (BO) and Born-Oppenheimer-Huang (BOH) treatments for electron-nuclear equation of motion have been considered as the cornerstone for qualitative as well as quantitative exploration and understanding of chemical and physical processes. The BO approximation due to the large mass difference between electrons and nuclei as well as the energy separation among the electronic states could able to predict some of the processes (chemical and physical) satisfactorily at lower energy regime. Such approximation (BO) quite often fails for those cases with the involvement of excited electronic states, in particular, due to the coupling among the states. On the other hand, the BO treatment provides two important quantities, namely, the adiabatic potential energy surfaces (PESs) and the nonadiabatic coupling terms (NACTs) determining the forces, which control the motion of the nuclei in a molecule. The NACTs play a major role in photoexcitation spectra, charge transfer chemical reactions, ferroelectric property and other processes, where significant anomalies are observed between single and multiple PES(s) results. Since the NACTs often exhibit singularity at the close vicinity of degenerate states forming conical intersections (CIs), such coupling terms could break the symmetry of the molecular processes changing the observables qualitatively.

AI.tldr: 该文讨论Born-Oppenheimer（BO）与Born-Oppenheimer-Huang（BOH）电子-核运动处理，重点分析绝热势能面（PESs）、非绝热耦合项（NACTs）及锥形交叉（CIs）在分子过程中的作用与局限。
AI.motivation: BO近似因电子与核质量差异大及电子态能隙而在低能区常能成功描述化学物理过程，但在涉及激发电子态及态间耦合时经常失效；因此需要理解PESs与NACTs如何决定核运动及非绝热效应。
AI.method: 基于BO/BOH框架对电子-核运动方程进行讨论，考察绝热PESs与NACTs，分析NACTs在简并态附近形成CIs时的奇异性，并比较单PES与多PES结果。
AI.result: NACTs在光激发谱、电荷转移化学反应、铁电性质等过程中起重要作用；在CIs附近NACTs常呈奇异性，可破坏分子过程对称性并定性改变可观测量，导致单PES与多PES结果显著差异。
AI.conclusion: BO/BOH处理是理解化学物理过程的重要基础，但对激发态与非绝热情形需显式考虑NACTs和CIs；这些耦合项及奇异性对准确预测非绝热过程至关重要。

title: General-purpose foundation models surpass specialized ones on chemical property prediction tasks
summary: Foundation models (FMs) learn reusable representations from large collections of unlabeled data. In chemistry the corresponding data mainly consists of molecular structures, which are abundant, whereas experimental measurements are scarce. Chemical FMs such as ChemBERTa and MoLFormer were therefore trained on diverse molecular structures to enable fine-tuning on small experimental datasets (less than 100 datapoints in most realistic scenarios) and subsequent property prediction. At the same time, general-purpose FMs such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 were trained on virtually all publicly available data, including knowledge of the humankind on molecular properties and laws governing them. Here we compare accuracies of chemical and general-purpose FMs on tasks from various areas of chemistry. Strikingly, general-purpose GPT-6 Astra outperforms the currently eligible chemical FMs on five physicochemical and quantum-chemical regression tasks when only 60 experimental datapoints are available. Only when provided 10x datapoints do the best chemical FMs reach performance of GPT-6 Astra: on 1,000 and 10,000 points they show performance on par with Astra on 60 and 1,000 points, respectively. Thus, counterintuitively, frontier general-purpose FMs are better suited for guiding chemical research in data-scarce areas than specialized chemical FMs, suggesting that learning relevant primitives (e.g. chemical structures) does not substitute training on relevant humankind knowledge.

AI.tldr: 在数据稀缺的化学性质预测任务中，通用基础模型GPT-6 Astra仅用60个实验数据点就优于专用化学基础模型；专用模型需约10倍数据才能达到同等性能。
AI.motivation: 化学领域分子结构数据丰富但实验测量稀缺。专用化学基础模型通常在大规模分子结构上预训练，再在小实验数据集上微调；而通用基础模型已在大规模公开数据中学习到分子性质及相关规律知识。作者希望比较两类模型在化学任务上的精度，尤其是在少样本条件下。
AI.method: 比较化学基础模型（如ChemBERTa、MoLFormer）与通用基础模型（如GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5）在多个化学领域的任务表现，重点评估五个物理化学和量子化学回归任务，并在仅60个实验数据点及更多数据点条件下比较预测精度。
AI.result: GPT-6 Astra在仅60个实验数据点时优于当前可用的化学基础模型。最佳化学基础模型需约10倍数据才能达到Astra在60点时的性能：在1,000和10,000个数据点上，分别达到Astra在60和1,000个数据点时的水平。
AI.conclusion: 与直觉相反，前沿通用基础模型在数据稀缺的化学研究中比专用化学基础模型更适合指导研究；仅学习分子结构等相关基元并不能替代对人类相关知识的大规模训练。

title: Estimating Irving-Kirkwood pressure profiles from per-atom virial and density profiles: a closure for the contour-dependent term in planar liquid films
summary: The local pressure tensor of an inhomogeneous fluid is not unique. Two tangential profiles are in common use in planar simulations: the Irving-Kirkwood (IK) profile, which requires a dedicated pass over every pair of atoms for every slab, and the per-atom virial (PAV) profile, which molecular-dynamics codes produce at negligible cost and coincides with the Harasima contour. The two differ by the derivative of a pair quantity, P_T^IK - P_T^PAV = dQ/dz. We show that, for Lennard-Jones free-standing films, Q(z) can be predicted from the density profile and the bulk radial distribution function of the coexisting liquid: under the closure rho2(r1,r2) ~ rho(z1) rho(z2) g(r12), with a pair-local interpolation of g between its liquid and dilute limits, Q is a double integral of rho(z) against a kernel built from u'(r) g(r). The estimator P_T^IK,est = P_T^PAV + dQ/dz is tested against IK profiles measured on the same trajectories for 20 films (thicknesses 7-25 sigma, three cutoff radii, two temperatures): the root-mean-square residual is 0.001-0.002 epsilon/sigma^3, against 0.010-0.021 for the uncorrected profile, and Q, the amount that the contour choice transfers between the two interfaces of a film with non-equivalent surfaces, is recovered to within 0.6% of the surface tension. Applied to the normal component, the same closure removes 83-92% of the spurious structure of the per-atom zz profile, a test that needs no IK run. Its mixture form is validated on three two-component films with an adsorbate unequally distributed between their faces, where it resolves the tension of each face; a clean face recovers the tension of the pure film.

AI.tldr: 非均匀流体的局部压力张量不唯一；Irving-Kirkwood (IK) 与 per-atom virial (PAV)/Harasima 切向压力剖面相差 dQ/dz。作者提出用密度剖面和共存液相体相径向分布函数预测 Q，从而以低成本 PAV 剖面重建近似 IK 剖面，并推广到混合物薄膜。
AI.motivation: PAV 剖面可由分子动力学几乎零成本得到，但与 IK 剖面存在轮廓选择差异；IK 需逐 slab 对所有原子对专门计算，代价高。需要一种廉价、准确且可用于自由站立薄膜和双组分界面张力分析的切向压力估计方法。
AI.method: 采用闭合近似 rho2(r1,r2) ~ rho(z1)rho(z2)g(r12)，并对 g(r) 在其液相极限与稀薄极限间做 pair-local 插值；将 Q(z) 表示为 rho(z) 与由 u'(r)g(r) 构建的核函数的双重积分。构造估计量 P_T^IK,est = P_T^PAV + dQ/dz；同一闭合也用于法向 zz 分量，并给出混合物形式以处理双组分薄膜。
AI.result: 在 20 个 Lennard-Jones 自由站立薄膜（厚度 7-25 sigma、三种截断半径、两个温度）上，估计量相对实测 IK 剖面的 RMS 残差为 0.001-0.002 epsilon/sigma^3，而未修正 PAV 为 0.010-0.021；Q 在非等价表面薄膜中两界面间的转移量恢复至表面张力的 0.6% 以内。用于法向分量时，该闭合消除了 per-atom zz 剖面 83-92% 的虚假结构，且无需运行 IK。混合物形式在三个吸附物在两表面分布不均的双组分薄膜上验证，可分辨各表面张力；洁净面恢复纯膜张力。
AI.conclusion: 轮廓选择导致的压力张量差异可由密度剖面与体相 g(r) 预测；该估计器使廉价 PAV 剖面能高精度逼近 IK 剖面，并为薄膜、双组分界面及逐面表面张力分析提供实用方法。

title: Second-order Bethe-Salpeter kernels: the interplay of vertex-corrected quasiparticle energies and the screened interaction
summary: We study second-order Bethe-Salpeter kernels generated by truncating an iterative formulation of Hedin's equations after the second cycle. Starting from the Hartree-Fock or the $GW$ self-energy, whose first cycles correspond to TDHF and $GW$+BSE, we obtain the second-cycle kernel by differentiating the first-cycle correlation self-energy with the interacting correlation function replaced by the non-interacting one, and evaluate it in the static limit of the effective kernel. Using fixed restricted Hartree-Fock orbitals, we benchmark 30 singlet and 28 triplet excitation energies for seven small molecules (six for the triplets) against the theoretical best estimates from QUEST v1.2. The second cycle lowers the mean absolute error (MAE) in both sequences. For the $GW$ sequence, the MAE decreases from 0.63 to 0.29 eV (singlets), on par with ADC(2) (0.30 eV), and from 0.43 to 0.38 eV (triplets). BSE$^{(2)}$@HF removes the triplet instabilities of TDHF and yields MAEs of 0.43 and 0.38 eV, or 0.31 and 0.30 eV when the Tamm-Dancoff approximation is applied in all cycles. Assigning the statically screened interaction $W_0$ to the exchange part of the $GW$ self-energy counts second-order screening twice in the second-cycle kernel and strongly blueshifts valence excitations. Without this double counting, dressing the exchange-type terms with $W_0$ lowers the singlet MAE from 0.37 to 0.29 eV but leaves the triplets nearly unchanged. Replacing second-order Green's function (GF2) quasiparticle energies by vertex-corrected ones in the same kernel raises excitation energies by about 0.7 eV, improving Rydberg but degrading valence excitations. A perturbative dynamical correction of the kernel blueshifts valence excitations by 0.3-0.4 eV and increases the errors of all full-matrix BSE$^{(2)}$ variants. The consistent improvement over the first cycle suggests that higher cycles are worth pursuing.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并基准测试由Hedin方程迭代截断至第二循环产生的二阶Bethe-Salpeter核，发现其相较第一循环TDHF/GW-BSE可系统降低激发能误差。
AI.motivation: 第一循环对应TDHF和GW+BSE，本文旨在检验进一步纳入第二循环相关自能导数核能否提高分子激发能精度并改善三重态稳定性。
AI.method: 从Hartree-Fock或GW自能出发，将第一循环相关自能中的相互作用关联函数替换为非相互作用形式并微分，在有效核静态极限下得到第二循环核；固定RHF轨道，对7个小分子的30个单重态和28个三重态激发能与QUEST v1.2理论最佳值比较。
AI.result: 第二循环降低两类序列MAE：GW序列单重态0.63→0.29 eV（与ADC(2)的0.30 eV相当），三重态0.43→0.38 eV；BSE(2)@HF消除TDHF三重态不稳定性，MAE为0.43/0.38 eV，全循环采用TDA时为0.31/0.30 eV。将W0赋给GW自能交换部分会重复计入二阶屏蔽并显著蓝移价态激发；避免重复计数后以W0修饰交换项使单重态MAE由0.37降至0.29 eV，三重态几乎不变。用顶点修正准粒子能替换GF2准粒子能使激发能约升高0.7 eV，改善Rydberg但恶化价态；微扰动态修正使价态蓝移0.3–0.4 eV并增大所有全矩阵BSE(2)变体误差。
AI.conclusion: 第二循环相对第一循环的一致改进表明更高阶循环值得进一步研究，但需谨慎处理屏蔽重复计数、准粒子能修正和动态核修正。

title: Benchmarking One-Dimensional Quantum Lattice Boltzmann Methods on Quantum Hardware
summary: Classical computational fluid dynamics (CFD) methods encounter significant computational bottlenecks in large systems and at high Reynolds number flows due to the rapid increase in degrees of freedom, even on flagship supercomputers. As quantum computers emerge, the Quantum Lattice Boltzmann Method (QLBM) has been proposed as a quantum-native alternative for solving fluid dynamics problems. However, until recently, nearly all studies have relied on classical quantum simulators rather than real quantum hardware. This study presents a benchmark of a one-dimensional QLBM implementation executed on three different IBM Quantum hardware. We design and test a quantum circuit for the advection-diffusion equation using amplitude encoding, a Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK)-type collision operator, and a streaming step with periodic boundary conditions. Our numerical experiments evaluate transpiled two-qubit gate count, total circuit depth, runtime, and accuracy metrics including maximum absolute error ($L_\infty$ norm) and root-mean-square error (RMSE). We find that the present collision and streaming operators dominate the overall cost and become the primary scalability bottleneck on current hardware. To mitigate the prohibitive cost of full quantum state tomography on hardware-based benchmarking exercises, we introduce a sampler-based measurement strategy that reconstructs macroscopic density fields directly from computational-basis measurements. This approach substantially reduces measurement overhead while preserving the expected advection-diffusion dynamics on hardware. These results provide a quantitative assessment of QLBM performance in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) regime and identify the principal algorithmic and experimental limitations that must be addressed for QLBM to become viable for fluid dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该文在真实 IBM Quantum 硬件上基准测试一维量子格子玻尔兹曼方法（QLBM），用于求解对流-扩散方程，并评估 NISQ 阶段的性能与瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 经典 CFD 在大系统和高雷诺数下自由度激增，计算瓶颈严重；QLBM 被视为量子原生替代方案，但此前研究多依赖量子模拟器而非真实量子硬件。
AI.method: 设计并测试基于振幅编码、BGK 型碰撞算子和周期边界流式步的量子线路；在三台 IBM Quantum 硬件上运行，统计编译后双量子比特门数、线路深度、运行时间，以及 L∞ 范数和 RMSE 等精度指标；提出基于采样的测量策略，从计算基测量直接重建宏观密度场以减少全量子态层析开销。
AI.result: 碰撞与流式算子主导总体成本，并成为当前硬件上的主要可扩展性瓶颈；采样测量策略显著降低测量开销，同时保持预期的对流-扩散动力学。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了 QLBM 在 NISQ 区的定量性能评估，并识别出其成为可行流体动力学求解方法前需解决的主要算法与实验限制。

title: Machine Learning-Enabled Time-Skipping Method: Theory and Perturbation-Based Verification
summary: Simulating the time evolution of practical mechanics problems requires many time steps. This cost is further compounded by the iterative nature of implicit solvers. We present a cycle-based Machine Learning-enabled Time-skipping (MLT) method. In each cycle, several time steps are skipped, a machine learning (ML) prediction bridges the gap to initialize one solver step, and the physics-based solver then runs for several steps to correct any accumulated errors. Using the Implicit Function Theorem, we derive first-order estimates that characterize how ML prediction errors propagate. These estimates identify when errors remain bounded across cycles and guide the choice of cycle parameters, independent of model architecture. We verify these estimates on the Allen-Cahn equation and a forced variant using controlled synthetic perturbations that emulate ML errors. Wall-clock measurements confirm the theoretical speedup is realizable in practice. The MLT method provides a robust framework for accelerating time-marching in dynamic simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出基于周期的机器学习时间跳跃（MLT）方法：跳过若干时间步，用ML预测桥接并初始化一次求解器步，再由物理求解器多步校正误差，以加速含隐式求解器的动力学仿真。
AI.motivation: 实际力学问题的时间演化仿真需要大量时间步，隐式求解器的迭代特性进一步放大计算成本，因此需要一种稳健的加速时间推进框架。
AI.method: MLT在每个周期内跳过多个时间步；由ML预测跨越被跳过区间并为一次物理求解器步提供初值，随后求解器执行若干步以校正累积误差。作者利用隐函数定理推导一阶误差传播估计，刻画ML预测误差如何跨周期传播，并据此判断误差是否有界及选择周期参数，且不依赖模型架构。
AI.result: 在Allen-Cahn方程及带强迫项变体上，用受控合成扰动模拟ML误差，验证了误差传播估计；实际墙钟时间测量表明理论加速可在实践中实现。
AI.conclusion: MLT为加速动态仿真中的时间推进提供了一种稳健框架，并给出了与模型架构无关的周期参数选择与误差有界性分析依据。

title: Feature-preserving interface reconstruction using piecewise circles and cusps
summary: We present a geometric interface reconstruction method for Volume-of-Fluid (VOF) simulations that captures both curved interfaces and sharp features using only volume fraction data. We represent interfaces with linear facets, circular arcs, and corner facets formed by two lines or arcs joined within a single cell. We first propagate local orientation constraints through a graph and merge cells to resolve ambiguities, treating topological consistency as a first-class constraint. An optional conservative refinement improves $C^0$ continuity while preserving local volume constraints. Users can independently enable circular facets, corner facets, cell merging, and continuity refinement to balance accuracy and computational cost. In its simplest configuration, our method provides a fast local line-fitting scheme competitive with state-of-the-art PLIC methods. On standard static benchmarks, the full configuration reconstructs identifiable lines, circles, and sufficiently resolved corners to numerical precision on coarse, perturbed Cartesian meshes. On varying-curvature interfaces, it achieves third-order convergence in facet-gap error and approximately first-order convergence in curvature error. These results demonstrate global volume conservation and accurate reconstruction of curved and corner features.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅利用体积分数数据的VOF几何界面重构方法，可同时捕捉曲面界面与尖锐角点特征。
AI.motivation: 传统VOF几何重构难以在仅有体积分数数据时兼顾曲面精度与角点/尖锐特征，并需在精度与计算成本间灵活权衡。
AI.method: 用线性面片、圆弧面片及由两条线或弧在同一单元内连接形成的角面片表示界面；通过图结构传播局部方向约束并合并单元以消解歧义，将拓扑一致性作为核心约束；可选保守细化提升C0连续性并保持局部体积约束；用户可独立启用圆弧面片、角面片、单元合并和连续性细化。
AI.result: 最简配置为快速局部线拟合方案，与先进PLIC方法相当；完整配置在粗化且扰动的笛卡尔网格上可将可识别直线、圆和充分分辨的角点重构到数值精度；在变曲率界面上，面片间隙误差达三阶收敛，曲率误差约一阶收敛，并实现全局体积守恒。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以模块化几何面片和拓扑约束实现仅基于体积分数的VOF界面重构，在保持体积守恒的同时准确重构曲面与角点特征，并可调节精度与成本。

title: AMPERe: an exactly divergence-free quadrature-by-expansion evaluator for near-surface Biot--Savart and virtual-casing fields in fusion geometries
summary: Accurate magnetic-field evaluation on and near current-carrying surfaces is a recurring computational bottleneck in magnetic-confinement fusion. As targets approach the source surface, Biot--Savart and virtual-casing kernels become singular, causing standard Gauss--Legendre and upsampled trapezoidal quadratures to lose accuracy. We introduce AMPERe, a quadrature-by-expansion (QBX) evaluator for vector magnetostatic kernels on general three-dimensional, non-axisymmetric tokamak and stellarator geometries. The method develops a spherical-harmonic QBX formulation for the vector Biot--Savart and virtual-casing (Stratton--Chu) fields and expresses the resulting magnetic field as the analytic curl of a regular-solid-harmonic vector potential. This construction yields a divergence-free discrete field at every expansion order, provides analytic derivatives, and enables an a priori separation of truncation, quadrature, and geometric errors. On the rotating-ellipse benchmark of Malhotra et al. [1], QBX maintains a relative error of 2--5 x 10^{-6} throughout the near-surface regime at distance-independent cost, whereas upsampled trapezoidal quadrature exhibits O(1) errors and requires node counts scaling as (h/d)^2. AMPERe is implemented as a header-only, performance-portable Kokkos library supporting CPU and GPU backends, with target-specific and local-correction accelerations validated against the baseline. The method is further demonstrated on realistic Wendelstein 7-X configurations, including sheet-current and virtual-casing field evaluations.

AI.tldr: AMPERe 是一种基于球谐 QBX 的矢量静磁核求值器，可在一般三维非轴对称托卡马克/仿星器几何上近表面高精度计算 Biot–Savart 与虚拟 casing 场，并支持 CPU/GPU。
AI.motivation: 磁约束聚变中，近电流承载表面的磁场评估是反复出现的计算瓶颈；Biot–Savart 与虚拟 casing 核在目标接近源面时奇异，标准 Gauss–Legendre 和上采样梯形求积会失去精度。
AI.method: 提出 AMPERe：针对矢量 Biot–Savart 与虚拟 casing（Stratton–Chu）场建立球谐 QBX 公式，将磁场表示为正则实谐矢量势的解析旋度；构造保证各展开阶离散场无散、提供解析导数，并可先验分离截断、求积与几何误差；实现为 header-only、性能可移植的 Kokkos 库，支持 CPU/GPU 后端及 target-specific 与 local-correction 加速。
AI.result: 在 Malhotra 等旋转椭圆基准上，QBX 在近表面区域保持 2–5×10^{-6} 的相对误差，成本与距离无关；上采样梯形求积出现 O(1) 误差且节点数需按 (h/d)^2 增长。方法进一步在 Wendelstein 7-X 实际位形上演示，包括 sheet-current 与虚拟 casing 场评估。
AI.conclusion: AMPERe 为一般三维非轴对称托卡马克与仿星器几何提供了近表面准确、高效且可扩展的矢量磁场求值方案，并验证了相对传统求积的显著精度与成本优势。

title: High-fidelity simulation and reduced-order modeling of optical pumping in quantum devices
summary: Spatially resolved modeling of optically pumped alkali-metal vapors requires the solution of a high-dimensional nonlinear diffusive quantum master equation (DQME) coupled to state-dependent light propagation. We develop a structure-preserving computational framework for this coupled three-dimensional system in the high-pressure limit. The high-fidelity solver combines second-order finite differences, explicit pseudo-time marching, and an exponential-integrator discretization of the light-propagation equation. The scheme preserves the density-matrix trace, while a derived global pseudo-time-step restriction guarantees nonnegative, bound-preserving population updates and frozen-coefficient $1$-norm stability. In the absence of a closed-form solution for the general coupled problem, the solver is verified against complementary analytical reductions, pumping-rate asymptotics, and a light-propagation invariant, all of which are accurately recovered. Tensorized GPU implementation reduces the per-iteration cost by more than two orders of magnitude relative to a single-core CPU. For repeated parameter queries, we further construct an intrusive POD--Galerkin reduced-order model. The quadratic spin-exchange term is treated by an exact nonlinear quadratic expansion, whereas the nonpolynomial and nonlocal optical-pumping term is hyper-reduced using the discrete empirical interpolation method. At out-of-sample parameter points, the reduced model closely reproduces the full-order population and polarization fields while achieving speedup of more than \(7\times10^3\) relative to the single-core CPU full-order solver. The resulting hierarchy connects verified high-fidelity simulation with efficient reduced-order prediction for spatially resolved alkali-metal spin dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出保结构数值框架求解三维非线性扩散量子主方程与态依赖光传播耦合，结合GPU加速和POD-Galerkin降阶模型实现高效空间分辨碱金属自旋动力学模拟。
AI.motivation: 空间分辨光泵碱金属蒸气建模需耦合求解高维非线性扩散量子主方程与光传播，计算代价高，且重复参数查询需要高效预测方法。
AI.method: 采用二阶有限差分、显式伪时间推进和光传播指数积分器，保持密度矩阵迹并给出全局伪时间步限制以保证非负、有界布居更新和冻结系数1-范数稳定；使用张量化GPU实现；构建侵入式POD-Galerkin降阶模型，自旋交换二次项精确展开，非多项式非局域光泵项用DEIM超缩减。
AI.result: 求解器通过解析约化、泵浦率渐近和光传播不变量验证；GPU使每次迭代成本较单核CPU降低两个数量级以上；样本外参数点下降阶模型准确复现全阶布居与极化场，较单核CPU全阶求解器加速超过7×10^3倍。
AI.conclusion: 形成连接经验证高保真仿真与高效降阶预测的方法层级，适用于空间分辨碱金属自旋动力学建模与重复参数查询。

title: Query-Efficient Quantum Multi-Objective Optimization for Materials Configuration Search via Bayesian Weight Selection
summary: Materials design is a multi-objective problem, and recent advances in quantum optimization make it possible to bring quantum solvers to bear on such problems. The realistic near-term win, though, is not raw quantum advantage but making an expensive, noisy quantum solver usable by spending its calls wisely. Quantum Approximate Multi-Objective Optimization (QAMOO) traces a Pareto front by solving a family of scalarized Ising problems, one per objective-weight vector, with QAOA --- but chooses those weights \emph{non-adaptively}, sampling them at random, blind to what it has already found. We recast weight selection as \emph{multi-objective Bayesian optimization}: our method, BW-QAMOO (Bayes-Weighted QAMOO), picks each next weight by expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI) under a Gaussian-process (GP) surrogate over the weight-to-objective map. On a frustrated alloy-configuration benchmark across $m\in\{3,4\}$ objectives and $n\in\{10,11,12\}$ sites, BW-QAMOO reaches the same Pareto hypervolume as QAMOO's random sampling with a median 33% fewer scalarized solves across the 90/95\% targets and 60--74\% fewer than a uniform-grid baseline), on a genuine (simulated) QAOA solver; a paired Wilcoxon test confirms the saving is significant, and the advantage grows with the objective count m as the weight simplex expands and blind sampling wastes more of the budget. This is a \emph{query-efficiency} result, and we close with the open challenges on the path to real alloy data and hardware.

AI.tldr: BW-QAMOO 将 QAMOO 中随机、非自适应的权重选择改为基于高斯过程代理模型与期望超体积改进（EHVI）的多目标贝叶斯优化，从而在模拟 QAOA 求解器上以更少标量化求解达到相同 Pareto 超体积。
AI.motivation: 材料设计本质上是多目标问题，近期量子优化有望处理此类问题；但近期的现实收益并非原始量子优势，而是通过更明智地使用昂贵且有噪声的量子求解器调用次数，提高其可用性。QAMOO 虽通过一族标量化 Ising 问题追踪 Pareto 前沿，却随机采样权重且忽略已获得的信息。
AI.method: 作者提出 BW-QAMOO（Bayes-Weighted QAMOO），把每个目标权重向量的选择建模为多目标贝叶斯优化：在权重到目标值映射上建立高斯过程（GP）代理模型，并用期望超体积改进（EHVI）选择下一个权重，再对该权重对应的标量化 Ising 问题调用 QAOA 求解。
AI.result: 在受挫合金构型基准上，目标数 m∈{3,4}、位点数 n∈{10,11,12}，BW-QAMOO 在真实（模拟）QAOA 求解器上达到与 QAMOO 随机采样相同的 Pareto 超体积，但在 90/95% 目标上标量化求解次数中位数少 33%，相比均匀网格基线少 60–74%；配对 Wilcoxon 检验表明节省显著，且随着目标数 m 增大、权重单纯形扩张、盲目采样浪费更多预算，优势进一步扩大。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出的是查询效率（query-efficiency）结果，而非原始量子优势；作者最后讨论了走向真实合金数据与真实硬件所面临的开放挑战。

title: A Momentum-weighted Interface Stabilization Approach for Fluid-Structure Interaction with Strong Added-Mass Effects
summary: Partitioned fluid-structure interaction (FSI) schemes permit the reuse of optimized standalone solvers but can become unstable under strong fluid added-mass effects, particularly when structural inertia is small relative to fluid inertia. This work traces the instability to the discrepancy between the interface pressure Schur complements of the monolithic and Dirichlet- Neumann partitioned systems, as revealed by a fixed-point analysis of the linearized FSI problem. Motivated by this analysis, a momentum-weighted interface stabilization (MWIS) is proposed, in which the interface pressure block of the fluid subproblem is augmented by an operator constructed from the fluid and structural interface momentum operators. The augmentation is consistent by construction, vanishing at convergence so that the monolithic solution is recovered. A sparse diagonal approximation of the operator, derived from element metrics, limits intersolver data exchange to quantities comparable in size to standard interface coupling data while requiring minimal modifications to the standalone solvers. Numerical experiments, spanning a linear model and established nonlinear FSI benchmarks, demonstrate improved coupling robustness in regimes of strong added-mass where the standard Dirichlet-Neumann scheme diverges.

AI.tldr: 该文从线性化FSI的定点分析出发，指出 Dirichlet-Neumann 分区格式在强附加质量效应下失稳源于分区与单体系统界面压力 Schur 补的不一致，并提出动量加权界面稳定化（MWIS）以恢复鲁棒耦合。
AI.motivation: 分区流固耦合可复用独立求解器，但在流体附加质量显著、结构惯性较小时易失稳；需要在不重写求解器的前提下改善 Dirichlet-Neumann 格式的稳定性。
AI.method: 通过线性化FSI的定点分析定位失稳机制为单体与分区系统界面压力 Schur 补差异；提出 MWIS，在流体子问题的界面压力块上加入由流体与结构界面动量算子构造的增广项。该增广在收敛时消失且保持一致，从而恢复单体解；并采用基于单元度量的稀疏对角近似，使跨求解器数据交换量与标准界面耦合数据相当，且仅需对独立求解器做少量修改。
AI.result: 在线性模型和已有非线性FSI基准上的数值实验表明，在标准 Dirichlet-Neumann 格式发散的强附加质量工况下，MWIS 能显著提高耦合鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MWIS 通过对界面压力块进行一致且收敛后消失的动量加权增广，以较低实现和数据交换代价缓解强附加质量导致的分区FSI失稳，并保持对单体解的恢复能力。
